en.title: Bill the Pony
en.gameText:
Bearer must be a Hobbit companion.  
The Shadow number of each site is -1. 
Discard Bill the Pony when at an underground site.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½That animal can nearly talk.... He gave me a look as plain as Mr. Pippin could speak....'ï¿½

en.title: Fireworks
en.gameText:
**Spell.**  
**Fellowship:** Spot Gandalf to shuffle up to 2 <symbol>gandalf</symbol> or up to 2 <symbol>shire</symbol> cards from your discard pile into your draw deck.

fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½Les plus belles fusï¿½es jamais vues, / En ï¿½toiles bleues et vertes, elles ï¿½clataient...ï¿½ ï¿½

**Magia.**
**Compagnia:** Avvista Gandalf per rimescolare nel tuo mazzo di gioco fino a 2 carte <symbol>gandalf</symbol> o fino a 2 carte <symbol>shire</symbol> dalla tua pila degli scarti.

es.gameText: **Hechizo.** **Comunidad:** Avista a Gandalf para mezclar hasta 2 cartas <symbol>gandalf</symbol> o hasta 2 cartas <symbol>shire</symbol> de tu pila de descartes en tu mazo de robar.
es.loreText: ï¿½Los mas hermosos fuegos nunca vistos: / estallaban en estrellas azules y verdes...ï¿½

en.title: Horn of Boromir
en.gameText:
Bearer must be Boromir.  
**Maneuver:** Exert Boromir and spot an ally.  Until the regroup phase, that ally is strength +3 and participates in archery fire and skirmishes.

fr.loreText: ï¿½ Sur un baudrier, il portait un grand cor ï¿½ bordure d'argent... ï¿½

de.loreText: An einem Gehenk trug er ein groï¿½es, silberbeschlagenes Horn...ï¿½

it.title: Corno di Boromir

Il possessore deve essere Boromir. 
**Manovra:** Sforza Boromir e avvista un alleato. Fino alla fase di raccolta, quellï¿½alleato aggiunge +3 alla forza e partecipa al tiro degli arcieri e alle schermaglie.

es.title: Cuerno de Boromir
es.gameText:
El portador debe ser Boromir. 
**Maniobra:** Esfuerza a Boromir y avista un aliado. Hasta la fase de reagrupaciï¿½n, ese aliado es fuerza +3 y participa en disparos de arquerï¿½a y escaramuzas.
es.loreText: ï¿½Sujeto a un tahalï¿½ llevaba un cuerno grande guarnecido de plata...ï¿½

en.title: Book of Mazarbul
en.gameText:
**Tale.**  Bearer must be a Dwarf.
At the start of each fellowship phase when the fellowship is at site 4 or higher, you may draw a card for each Dwarf companion.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½It seems to be a record of the fortunes of Balin's folk....'ï¿½

**Rï¿½cit.**

de.title: Das Buch von Mazarbul
de.gameText:
**Erzï¿½hlung.**

it.gameText:
**Racconto.** Il possessore deve essere un Nano.
Allï¿½inizio di ogni fase della Compagnia, quando la compagnia ï¿½ al sito 4 o successivo, puoi pescare una carta per ogni compagno Nano.

es.title: Libro de Mazarbul
es.gameText: **Cuento.** El portador debe ser un Enano. Al principio de cada fase de comunidad cuando la comunidad esta en el sitio 4 o superior, puedes robar una carta por cada compaï¿½ero Enano.
es.loreText: ï¿½Parece ser un registro de los azares y fortunas que cayeron sobre el pueblo de Balin...ï¿½

en.title: Phial of Galadriel
en.gameText:
To play, exert an Elf.  Bearer must be the Ring-bearer. 
Bearerï¿½s resistance is +2.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½May it be a light to you in dark places, when all other lights go out. Remember Galadriel and her Mirror!'ï¿½

Pour jouer, affaiblissez un Elfe. Le dï¿½tenteur doit ï¿½tre le Porteur de lï¿½Anneau.
Le dï¿½tenteur a +2 en rï¿½sistance.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½Qu'elle vous soit une lumiï¿½re dans les endroits tï¿½nï¿½breux, quand toutes les autres lumiï¿½res s'ï¿½teindront. Souvenez-vous de Galadriel et de son Miroir!ï¿½ ï¿½

Per giocarlo, sforza un Elfo. Il possessore deve essere il Portatore dellï¿½Anello.

es.title: Vial de Galadriel
es.gameText: Para jugarlo, esfuerza un Elfo. El portador debe ser el Portador del Anillo. La resistencia del Portador es +2.
es.loreText: ï¿½Que sea para ti una luz en los sitios oscuros, cuando todas las otras luces se hayan extinguido. ï¿½Recuerda a Galadriel y el Espejo!ï¿½

en.title: The Balrog
en.subtitle: Durin's Bane
en.gameText:
**Damage +1.** **Fierce.** 
While you can spot The Balrog, discard all other minions. Skip the archery phase. Discard The Balrog if not underground.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Indeed I saw upon the bridge that which haunts our darkest dreams....'ï¿½

fr.title: Le Balrog
fr.subtitle: Le Flï¿½au de Durin

**Dï¿½gï¿½ts +1.** **Acharnï¿½.**
Lorsque vous pouvez dï¿½signer Le Balrog, dï¿½faussez tous les autres sï¿½ides. Ignorer la phase dï¿½archerie. Dï¿½faussez Le Balrog si vous nï¿½ï¿½tes pas ï¿½ un site souterrain.</keyword>
fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½En vï¿½ritï¿½, j'ai vu sur le pont ce qui hante nos pires cauchemars...ï¿½ ï¿½

de.subtitle: Durins Fluch
de.gameText:
**Schaden +1.** **Erbittert.**

**Danno +1.** **Feroce.**

it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Vidi davvero su quel ponte ciï¿½ che ossessiona i nostri sogni piï¿½ oscuri...'ï¿½

es.title: El Balrog
es.subtitle: El Daï¿½o de Durin
es.gameText: **Daï¿½o +1.** **Fiero.** Mientras puedas avistar El Balrog, descarta todos los otros siervos. Sï¿½ltate la fase de arquerï¿½a. Descarta El Balrog si no estï¿½ en un sitio **Subterrï¿½neo.**

en.title: Saruman
en.subtitle: Servant of the Eye
en.gameText:
Saruman may not take wounds during the archery phase and may not be assigned to a skirmish. 
**Assignment:** Exert Saruman to assign an <symbol>isengard</symbol> minion to a companion (except the Ring-bearer). That companion may exert to prevent this.

fr.subtitle: Serviteur de l'ï¿½il
fr.gameText: Saroumane ne peut pas prendre de blessure pendant la phase dï¿½archerie et ne peut pas ï¿½tre affectï¿½ ï¿½ un combat. **Affectation :** Affaiblissez Saroumane pour affecter un sï¿½ide <symbol>isengard</symbol> ï¿½ un compagnon (exceptï¿½ le Porteur de lï¿½Anneau). Ce compagnon peut sï¿½affaiblir pour empï¿½rche l'affectation.

de.subtitle: Vasall des Einen Auges
de.gameText:
Saruman darf in der Fernkampfphase keine Wunde erleiden und darf keinem Kampf zugewiesen werden.

it.subtitle: Servitore dell'Occhio
it.gameText:
Saruman non puï¿½ subire ferite durante la fase degli arcieri e non puï¿½ essere assegnato a una schermaglia.

es.gameText: Saruman no puede recibir heridas durante la fase de arquerï¿½a y no puede ser asignado a una escaramuza. **Asignaciï¿½n:** Esfuerza a Saruman para asignar un siervo <symbol>isengard</symbol> a un compaï¿½ero (excepto al Portador del Anillo). Ese compaï¿½ero se puede esforzar para prevenir eso.

en.title: Gimli
en.subtitle: Son of Glï¿½in
en.gameText:
**Damage +1**. 
**Skirmish:** Exert Gimli to make him strength +2.
en.loreText: ï¿½'Then it has all been in vain ï¿½ the Fellowship has failed.'ï¿½

fr.title: Gimli
fr.subtitle: Fils de Glï¿½in
fr.gameText:
**Dï¿½gï¿½ts +1.**
**Combat :** Affaiblissez Gimli pour lui donner +2 en force.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½ cï¿½tï¿½ de Glï¿½in se trouvait un jeune Nain: son fils Gimli.ï¿½

de.title: Gimli
de.subtitle: Sohn des Glï¿½in
de.gameText:
**Schaden +1.**
**Kampf** Strenge Gimli an, um ihm Stï¿½rke +2 zu geben.

it.title: Gimli
it.subtitle: Figlio di Glï¿½in
it.gameText:
**Danno +1.**
**Schermaglia:** Sforza Gimli per aggiungere +2 alla sua forza.
it.loreText: ï¿½C'era un Nano piï¿½ giovane al fianco di Glï¿½in: suo figlio Gimli.ï¿½

es.title: Gimli
es.subtitle: Hijo de Gloin
es.gameText:
**Daï¿½o +1.**

en.title: Legolas
en.subtitle: Greenleaf
en.gameText:
**Archer.**

**Archer.**

de.subtitle: Grï¿½nblatt
de.gameText:
**Bogenschï¿½tze.**

**Arciere.**

es.subtitle: Hojaverde

en.subtitle: Ranger of the North
en.gameText:
**Ranger.**

fr.title: Aragorn
fr.subtitle: Rï¿½deur du Nord

**Rï¿½deur.**

de.subtitle: Waldlï¿½ufer des Nordens
de.gameText:
**Waldlï¿½ufer.**

it.title: Aragorn
it.subtitle: Ramingo del Nord
it.gameText:
**Ramingo.**

it.loreText: Viaggeremo leggeri. Andiamo a caccia di Orchi.

es.title: Aragorn
es.subtitle: Montaraz del Norte
es.gameText:
**Montaraz.**

en.title: Legolas
en.subtitle: Son of Thranduil
en.gameText:
**Archer.**  
While Legolas is at a river or forest, add 1 to the fellowship archery total.

fr.title: Legolas
fr.subtitle: Fils de Thranduil
fr.gameText:
**Archer.**
Tant que Legolas est ï¿½ une riviï¿½re ou une forï¿½t, ajoutez 1 au total dï¿½archerie de la compagnie.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½Louï¿½s soient l'arc de Galadriel et la main et l'*il de Legolas!... Ce fut un beau tir dans l'obscuritï¿½, ami!ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Legolas
de.subtitle: Sohn des Thranduil
de.gameText:
**Bogenschï¿½tze.**
Solange sich Legolas an einem Fluss oder in einem Wald befindet, erhï¿½ht sich der Fernkampfwert der Gemeinschaft um 1.
de.loreText: Gepriesen seien Galadriels Bogen, und Hand und Auge von Legolas!... Das war ein mï¿½chtiger Schuss im Dunkeln, mein Freund!ï¿½

it.title: Legolas
it.subtitle: Figlio di Thranduil
it.gameText:
**Arciere.**
Quando Legolas ï¿½ a un fiume o in una foresta, aggiungi +1 al totale degli arcieri della Compagnia.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Lodati siano l'arco di Galadriel, e la mano e la vista di Legolas!... Che meraviglioso tiro nel buio, amico mio!'ï¿½

es.title: Legolas
es.subtitle: Hijo de Thranduil
es.gameText: **Arquero.** Mientras Legolas estï¿½ en un rï¿½o o un bosque, aï¿½ade 1 al total de arquerï¿½a de la comunidad.
es.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Alabados sean el arco de Galadriel y la mano y el ojo de Legolas!... ï¿½Un buen tiro en la oscuridad, amigo mï¿½o!ï¿½

en.title: Faramir
en.subtitle: Son of Denethor
en.gameText:
**Ring-bound. Ranger.**
An opponent may not play skirmish events or use skirmish special abilities during skirmishes involving Faramir.
en.loreText: ï¿½'...if you will trust me, it may be that I can advise you in your present quest, whatever that be ï¿½ yes, and even aid you.'ï¿½

fr.title: Faramir
fr.subtitle: Fils de Denethor
fr.gameText:
**Associï¿½ ï¿½ lï¿½Anneau.** **Rï¿½deur.**
Un adversaire ne peut pas jouer dï¿½ï¿½vï¿½nements de combat ou utiliser des capacitï¿½s spï¿½ciales de combat pendant les combats qui impliquent Faramir.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ Il voyait le visage de Faramir, ï¿½ prï¿½sent dï¿½masquï¿½: il ï¿½tait sï¿½vï¿½re et imposant; une intelligence aiguï¿½ paraissait dans son regard scrutateur. ï¿½

de.title: Faramir
de.subtitle: Sohn des Denethor
de.gameText:
**Ring-verbunden.** **Waldlï¿½ufer.**
Deine Gegenspieler dï¿½rfen in Kï¿½mpfen, an denen Faramir beteiligt ist, keine Kampfereignisse spielen oder spezielle Kampffï¿½higkeiten benutzen.
de.loreText: Er sah Faramirs Gesicht, der jetzt keine Maske trug: es war streng und herrisch, und ein scharfer Verstand sprach aus seinem forschenden Blick.

it.title: Faramir
it.subtitle: Figlio di Denethor
it.gameText:
**Legato allï¿½Anello.** **Ramingo.**
Un avversario non puï¿½ giocare eventi di schermaglia o usare abilitï¿½ speciali di schermaglia durante le schermaglie che coinvolgano Faramir.
it.loreText: ï¿½Vedeva il viso di Faramir, ora senza maschera: era severo ed imperioso, e dietro al suo sguardo investigatore si nascondeva un'intelligenza acuta.ï¿½

es.title: Faramir
es.subtitle: Hijo de Denethor
es.gameText: **Vinculado al Anillo.** **Montaraz.** Un oponente no puede jugar eventos de escaramuza ni usar habilidades especiales de escaramuza durante escaramuzas en las que participe Faramir.
es.loreText: ï¿½Veï¿½a el rostro de Faramir, ahora desenmascarado: era severo e imperioso; y detrï¿½s de aquella mirada escrutadora brillaba una viva inteligencia.ï¿½

en.title: ï¿½owyn
en.subtitle: Lady of Rohan
en.gameText:
**Valiant.**
**Response:** If an unbound companion is about to take a wound, exert ï¿½owyn and add <symbol>twilight1</symbol> to prevent that wound.
en.loreText: ï¿½There is ï¿½owyn, daugher of ï¿½omund.... She is fearless and high-hearted.  All love her.ï¿½

fr.title: ï¿½owyn
fr.subtitle: Dame de Rohan
fr.gameText:
**Vaillant.**

fr.loreText: ï¿½ C'est ainsi qu'Aragorn vit pour la premiï¿½re fois... ï¿½owyn, Dame de Rohan, et il la trouva belle, belle et froide, comme un pï¿½le matin de printemps, non encore parvenue ï¿½ la plï¿½nitude de la femme. ï¿½

de.title: ï¿½owyn
de.subtitle: Herrin von Rohan
de.gameText:
**Tapfer.**
**Reaktion:** Strenge ï¿½owyn an und erhï¿½he den Einfluss um <symbol>twilight1</symbol>, wenn ein nicht-verbundener Gefï¿½hrte verwundet wird, um diese Wunde zu verhindern.
de.loreText: So erblickte Aragorn... ï¿½owyn... und fand sie schï¿½n, schï¿½n und kalt wie ein Morgen im bleichen Frï¿½hling, noch nicht zur Fraulichkeit gereift.

it.title: ï¿½owyn
it.subtitle: Dama di Rohan

**Fellowship:** Exert a Dwarf to reveal the top 3 cards of any draw deck. You may discard 1 Shadow card revealed. 
Return the rest in any order.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½I will go and look on the halls of Durin, whatever may wait there....'ï¿½

fr.title: Les Salles de ma Patrie
fr.gameText: **Compagnie :** Affaiblissez un Nain pour rï¿½vï¿½ler les 3 premiï¿½res cartes de nï¿½importe quelle pioche. Vous pouvez dï¿½fausser 1 carte de lï¿½Ombre rï¿½vï¿½lï¿½e. Replacez les autres dans nï¿½importe quel ordre.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½J'irai regarder les salles de Durin, quel que soit le sort qui m'y attend....'ï¿½

de.title: Die Hallen meiner Ahnen
de.gameText: **Gemeinschaft.** Strenge einen Zwerg an, um die obersten 3 Karten eines beliebigen Spieldecks aufzudecken. Du darfst davon 1 Schattenkarte ablegen und die ï¿½brigen Karten in beliebiger Reihenfolge wieder zurï¿½cklegen.
de.loreText: Ich will mitgehen und einen Blick auf Durins Hallen werfen, was immer dort auf uns wartet...ï¿½

it.title: Le Sale della Mia Dimora
it.gameText: **Compagnia:** Sforza un Nano per mostrare le prime 3 carte di un qualsiasi mazzo di gioco. Puoi scartare 1 carta Ombra mostrata. Reinserisci il resto in qualsiasi ordine.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Andrï¿½ a mirare le dimore di Durin, noncurante di ciï¿½ che ivi potrebbe attenderci...'ï¿½

es.title: Salas de Mi Hogar
es.gameText: **Comunidad:** Esfuerza un Enano para revelar las 3 cartas superiores de cualquier mazo de robar. Puedes descartar una carta de Sombra revelada. Devuelve el resto en cualquier orden.
es.loreText: ï¿½Irï¿½ contigo y explorare las salas de Durin, cualquiera que sea el riesgo...ï¿½

en.title: Here Lies Balin, Son of Fundin
en.gameText: **Maneuver:** Exert a Dwarf to wound 2 Orcs or to wound 1 Orc twice.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½I have looked on Moria, and it is very great, but it has become dark and dreadful; and we have found no sign of my kindred.'ï¿½

fr.title: Ici Repose Balin, Fils de Fundin
fr.gameText: **Manï¿½uvre :** Affaiblissez un Nain pour blesser 2 Orques ou pour blesser 1 Orque deux fois.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½J'ai regardï¿½ la Moria, et elle est trï¿½s grande, mais elle est devenue sombre et terrible ; et nous n'avons trouvï¿½ aucun signe de ceux de ma race.'ï¿½

de.title: Hier liegt Balin, Fundins Sohn
de.gameText: **Manï¿½ver:** Strenge einen Zwerg an, um 2 Orks zu verwunden, oder 1 Ork zweimal.
de.loreText: Ich habe Moria gesehen, und es ist sehr groï¿½, aber es ist dunkel und schrecklich; und wir haben keine Spur von meiner Sippe gefunden.ï¿½

it.title: Qui Giace Balin, Figlio di Fundin
it.gameText: **Manovra:** Sforza un Nano per ferire 2 Orchi o per ferire 1 Orco due volte.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Il mio sguardo si ï¿½ posato su Moria; ï¿½ immensa, ma ï¿½ divenuta oscura e spaventosa, e non vi ï¿½ traccia della mia gente.'ï¿½

es.title: Aquï¿½ Yace Balin, Hijo de Fundin
es.gameText: **Maniobra:** Esfuerza un Enano para herir 2 Orcos o herir dos veces 1 Orco.
es.loreText: ï¿½Ya he visto Moria, y es muy grande, pero se ha convertido en un sitio oscuro y terrible, y no hemos encontrado seï¿½ales de mi gente.ï¿½

en.title: Let Them Come!
en.gameText: Each time a Dwarf wins a skirmish against an Orc, discard that Orc. Discard this condition if a Dwarf loses a skirmish.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½There is one Dwarf yet in Moria who still draws breath!'ï¿½

fr.title: Laissez-les Venir !
fr.gameText: Chaque fois quï¿½un Nain remporte un combat contre un Orque, dï¿½faussez cet Orque. Dï¿½faussez cette situation si un Nain perd un combat.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Il y a encore un Nain dans la Moria ï¿½ qui il reste du souffle !'ï¿½

de.title: Lasst sie nur kommen!
de.gameText: Spiele diese Karte in deinen Unterstï¿½tzungs-bereich. Jedesmal, wenn ein Zwerg einen Kampf gegen einen Ork gewinnt, lege den Ork ab. Lege diesen Effekt ab, wenn ein Zwerg einen Kampf verliert.
de.loreText: Noch gibt es einen Zwerg in Moria, der atmet!ï¿½

it.title: Lasciateli Venire!
it.gameText: Ogni volta che un Nano vince una schermaglia contro un Orco, scarta quellï¿½Orco. Scarta questa condizione se un Nano perde una schermaglia.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½C'ï¿½ ancora un Nano a Moria che respira!'ï¿½

es.title: ï¿½Dejad Que Vengan!
es.gameText: Cada vez que un Enano gana una escaramuza contra un Orco, descarta ese Orco. Descarta esta condiciï¿½n si un Enano pierde una escaramuza.
es.loreText: ï¿½Hay un Enano en Moria que todavï¿½a respira!ï¿½

en.title: Lord of Moria
en.gameText: Each Dwarf is **damage +1.**
en.loreText: Gimli rushed ahead into the vast, empty chamber to see a huge slab of white stone. Knowing instinctively the significance of this tomb, he fell to his knees, overcome with grief.

fr.title: Seigneur de la Moria
fr.gameText: Chaque Nain inflige des **dï¿½gï¿½ts +1.**
fr.loreText: Gimli s'engouffra dans la vaste chambre vide et vit une ï¿½norme dalle de pierre blanche. Reconnaissant instinctivement cette tombe, il tomba ï¿½ genoux, submergï¿½ par le chagrin.

de.title: Herr von Moria
de.gameText: Spiele diese Karte in deinen Unterstï¿½tzungs-bereich. Jeder Zwerg erhï¿½lt **Schaden +1.**
de.loreText: Gimli stï¿½rzte voran in die weite, leere Kammer und sah dort eine groï¿½e, weisse Steinplatte. Er fï¿½hlte die Bedeutung dieser Grabstï¿½tte und fiel, von Trauer ï¿½bermannt, auf die Knie.

it.title: Signore di Moria
it.gameText: Ogni Nano aggiunge **Danno +1.**
it.loreText: Gimli si precipitï¿½ in avanti nella vasta, vuota sala per vedere un'enorme lastra di pietra bianca. Intuendo istintivamente l'importanza di questa tomba, cadde sulle sue ginocchia, avanzï¿½ con dolore.

es.title: Seï¿½or de Moria
es.gameText: Cada Enano es **daï¿½o +1.**
es.loreText: Gimli se apresuro en la gran cï¿½mara vacï¿½a para ver una enorme losa de piedra blanca. Conociendo instintivamente el significado de esta tumba, se arrodillo, superado por la pena.

en.title: Mithril Shaft
en.gameText: **Maneuver:** Exert a Dwarf to discard cards from the top of your draw deck until you choose to stop (limit 5). Add <symbol>twilight1</symbol> for each card discarded in this way. Take the last card discarded into hand.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Mithril! All folk desired it.'ï¿½

fr.title: Puits de Mithril
fr.gameText: **Manï¿½uvre :** Affaiblissez un Nain pour dï¿½fausser des cartes du dessus de votre pioche jusquï¿½ï¿½ ce que vous dï¿½cidiez dï¿½arrï¿½ter (limitï¿½ ï¿½ 5). Ajoutez <symbol>twilight1</symbol> pour chaque carte dï¿½faussï¿½e de cette maniï¿½re. Prenez la derniï¿½re carte dï¿½faussï¿½e en main.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Le mithril ! Il faisait l'objet du dï¿½sir de tous.'ï¿½

de.title: Mithrilader
de.gameText: **Manï¿½ver:** Strenge einen Zwerg an, um solange die obersten Karten von deinem Spieldeck (maximal 5) abzulegen, wie du mï¿½chtest. Erhï¿½he den Einfluss um <symbol>twilight1</symbol> fï¿½r jede abgelegte Karte. Die letzte Karte, die du ablegst, nimmst du auf deine Hand.
de.loreText: Mithril! Jedermann wollte es.ï¿½

it.title: Vena di Mithril
it.gameText: **Manovra:** Sforza un Nano per scartare la carta in cima al tuo mazzo di gioco finchï¿½ non scegli di fermarti (limite 5). Aggiungi <symbol>twilight1</symbol> per ogni carta scartata in questo modo. Aggiungi lï¿½ultima carta scartata alla mano.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Mithril! Tutti i popoli lo desideravano.'ï¿½

es.title: Veta de Mithril
es.gameText: **Maniobra:** Esfuerza un Enano para descartar cartas de tu mazo de robar hasta que decidas parar (lï¿½mite 5). Aï¿½ade <symbol>twilight1</symbol> por cada carta descartada de este modo. Pon la ï¿½ltima carta descartada en tu mano.
es.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Mithril! Todo el mundo lo deseaba.ï¿½

en.title: Nobody Tosses a Dwarf
en.gameText: **Response:** If a Dwarf wins a skirmish, make an opponent discard 3 cards from the top of his or her draw deck.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½My folk have never had dealings with any of the servants of the Enemy.'ï¿½

fr.title: Personne ne Lance un Nain
fr.gameText: **Rï¿½ponse :** Si un Nain remporte un combat, obligez un adversaire ï¿½ dï¿½fausser 3 cartes du dessus de sa pioche.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Les miens n'ont jamais eu de rapports avec aucun serviteur de l'Ennemi.'ï¿½

de.title: Niemand schubst einen Zwerg herum!
de.gameText: **Reaktion:** Wenn ein Zwerg einen Kampf gewinnt, muss dein Gegenspieler die obersten 3 Karten von seinem Spieldeck ablegen.
de.loreText: Mein Volk hat niemals mit irgendeinem der Diener des Feindes etwas zu tun gehabt.ï¿½

it.title: Nessuno Calunni un Nano
it.gameText: **Risposta:** Se un Nano vince una schermaglia, fai scartare a un avversario le prime 3 carte del suo mazzo di gioco.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Il mio popolo non ha mai avuto rapporti con alcuno dei servitori del Nemico.'ï¿½

es.title: Nadie Deja de Lado a un Enano
es.gameText: **Respuesta:** Si un enano gana una Escaramuza, haz que el oponente descarte las tres cartas superiores de su mazo de robar.
es.loreText: ï¿½Mi gente nunca ha tenido tratos con los sirvientes del Enemigo.ï¿½

en.title: Stairs of Khazad-dï¿½m
en.gameText:
**Tale.** 
While a Dwarf skirmishes a <symbol>moria</symbol> minion, that Dwarf is strength +1.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Moria ï¿½ Khazad-dï¿½m! Greatest of the dwarf-halls ï¿½ What I would not give to look upon its treasures!'ï¿½

fr.title: Escalier de Khazad-dï¿½m
fr.gameText:
**Rï¿½cit.**
Tant quï¿½un Nain combat un sï¿½ide <symbol>moria</symbol>, ce Nain a +1 en force.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½La Moria ï¿½ Khazad-dï¿½m ! La plus grande des demeures naines ï¿½ Que ne donnerais-je pas pour examiner ses trï¿½sors !'ï¿½

de.title: Die Treppen von Khazad-dï¿½m
de.gameText:
**Erzï¿½hlung.**
Wenn ein Zwerg einen <symbol>moria</symbol> Diener bekï¿½mpft, erhï¿½lt dieser Zwerg Stï¿½rke +1.
de.loreText: Moria ï¿½ Khazad-dï¿½m! Grï¿½ï¿½tes aller Zwergenreiche ï¿½ Was wï¿½rde ich nicht alles geben, seine Pracht zu sehen!ï¿½

it.title: Le Scale di Khazad-dï¿½m
it.gameText: **Racconto.** Mentre un Nano sta schermagliando con un servitore <symbol>moria</symbol>, quel Nano aggiunge +1 alla forza.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Moria ï¿½ Khazad-dï¿½m! Il piï¿½ grande palazzo dei Nani ï¿½ Cosa non darei per sbirciare i suoi tesori!'ï¿½

es.title: Escaleras de Khazad-dï¿½m
es.gameText: **Cuento.**Cuando un Enano este en una escaramuza contra un siervo <symbol>moria</symbol>, ese Enano es fuerza +1.
es.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½ï¿½Moria ï¿½ Khazad-dï¿½m! El mï¿½s grande de los pabellones Enanos ï¿½ Que no darï¿½a por contemplar sus tesoros!'ï¿½

en.title: Still Draws Breath
en.gameText: **Response:** If a Dwarf wins a skirmish, heal that Dwarf.
en.loreText: ï¿½When thirteen had fallen the rest fled shrieking, leaving the defenders unharmed....ï¿½

fr.title: Encore du Souffle
fr.gameText: **Rï¿½ponse :** Si un Nain remporte un combat, guï¿½rissez ce Nain.
fr.loreText: ï¿½Quand treize furent tombï¿½s, les autres s'enfuirent en hurlant, laissant les dï¿½fenseurs indemnes....ï¿½

de.title: Er atmet noch
de.gameText: **Reaktion:** Wenn ein Zwerg einen Kampf gewinnt, heile diesen Zwerg.
de.loreText: Als dreizehn gefallen waren, ergriffen die ï¿½brigen schreiend die Flucht und liessen die Verteidiger unverletzt zurï¿½ck...ï¿½

it.title: Respira Ancora
it.gameText: **Risposta:** Se un Nano vince una schermaglia, cura quel Nano.
it.loreText: ï¿½Quando ne furono caduti tredici, gli altri fuggirono strillando, lasciando la Compagnia illesa....ï¿½

es.title: Todavï¿½a Respira
es.gameText: **Respuesta:** Si un Enano gana una escaramuza, cura ese Enano.
es.loreText: ï¿½Cuando ya habï¿½an caï¿½do trece, el resto huyo chillando, dejando a los defensores indemnes...ï¿½

en.title: Their Halls of Stone
en.gameText: **Skirmish:** Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or +4 if at an underground site).
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½These are not holes,' said Gimli. ï¿½This is the great realm and city of the Dwarrowdelf. And of old it was not darksome, but full of light and splendour, as is still remembered in our songs.'ï¿½

fr.title: Leurs Demeures de Pierre
fr.gameText: **Combat :** Donnez +2 en force (ou +4 sï¿½il est ï¿½ un site souterrain) ï¿½ un Nain.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Ce ne sont pas des trous', dit Gimli. ï¿½C'est le grand royaume et domaine du Cavenain. Et jadis il n'ï¿½tait pas sombre, mais plein de lumiï¿½re et de splendeur, comme nous nous le rappelons dans nos chansons.'ï¿½

de.title: Ihre Hallen aus Stein
de.gameText: **Kampf** Gib einem Zwerg Stï¿½rke +2 (oder Stï¿½rke +4, wenn er sich an einem unterirdischen Ort befindet).
de.loreText: Das sind keine Hï¿½hlenï¿½, antwortete Gimli. "Dies ist das groï¿½e Reich und die Stadt Zwergenbinge. Und einstmals war es hier nicht dunkel, sondern voller Licht und Glanz, wie es noch in unseren Liedern ï¿½berliefert wird.ï¿½

it.title: I Loro Saloni di Pietra
it.gameText: **Schermaglia:** Aggiungi +2 alla forza di un Nano (o +4 se in un sito sotterraneo).
it.loreText: ï¿½Questi non sono buchiï¿½, disse Gimli. ï¿½Qui ï¿½ il grande reame e la cittï¿½ del Nanosterro. In antico non era tenebroso, bensï¿½ inondato di luce e splendore, come ancora ricordano le nostre canzoniï¿½

es.title: Sus Salas de Piedra
es.gameText: **Escaramuza:** Da a un Enano fuerza +2 (+4 si estï¿½ en un sitio subterrï¿½neo).
es.loreText: ï¿½No son agujeros ï¿½ dijo Gimli ï¿½. Esto es el gran reino y la ciudad de la Mina del Enano. Y antiguamente no era oscura sino luminosa y esplï¿½ndida, como lo recuerdan aï¿½n nuestras canciones.ï¿½

en.title: Thrarin
en.subtitle: Dwarven Smith
en.gameText: **Maneuver:** Exert Thrarin to allow him to participate in archery fire and skirmishes until the regroup phase.
en.loreText: A blacksmith by trade, Thrarin puts down his hammer and takes up his axe to fight when the need arises.

fr.title: Thrarin
fr.subtitle: Forgeron Nain
fr.gameText: **Manï¿½uvre :** Affaiblissez Thrarin pour lui permettre de participer au tir des archers et aux combats jusquï¿½ï¿½ la phase de ralliement.
fr.loreText: Forgeron de mï¿½tier, Thrarin dï¿½pose son marteau et prend sa hache pour combattre quand le besoin s'en fait sentir.

de.title: Thrarin
de.subtitle: Zwergenschmied
de.gameText: **Manï¿½ver:** Strenge Thrarin an, damit er bis zur Sammelphase an Fernkampf und Kampf teilnehmen kann.
de.loreText: Eigentlich ein Hufschmied, legt Thrarin seinen Hammer nieder, wenn nï¿½tig, und ergreift seine Axt, um zu kï¿½mpfen.

it.title: Thrarin
it.subtitle: Fabbro dei Nani
it.gameText: **Manovra:** Sforza Thrarin per permettergli di partecipare al tiro degli arcieri e alla fase di schermaglia fino alla fase di raccolta.
it.loreText: Fabbro ferraio di professione, Tharin mette giï¿½ il suo martello e prende la sua ascia per combattere quando si presenti la necessitï¿½.

es.title: Thrarin
es.subtitle: Herrero Enano
es.gameText: **Maniobra:** Esfuerza a Thrarin para permitirle participar en disparos de arquerï¿½a y escaramuzas hasta la fase de reagrupaciï¿½n.
es.loreText: De oficio herrero, Thrarin deja su martillo y toma su hacha para luchar cuando surge la necesidad.

en.title: Wealth of Moria
en.gameText: **Fellowship:** Spot a Dwarf to reveal the top 3 cards of your draw deck. Take all Free Peoples cards revealed into hand and discard the rest.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½For here alone in all the world was found Moria-silver, or true-silver as some have called it: mithril is the Elvish name.'ï¿½

fr.title: Richesse de la Moria
fr.gameText: **Compagnie :** Dï¿½signez un Nain pour rï¿½vï¿½ler les 3 premiï¿½res cartes de votre pioche. Prenez en main toutes les cartes de Peuples Libres rï¿½vï¿½lï¿½es et dï¿½faussez les autres.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Du monde entier ce n'est qu'ici qu'on trouvait l'argent de la Moria ou vrai-argent, comme d'aucuns l'ont appelï¿½. Mithril est son nom elfique.'ï¿½

de.title: Morias Reichtum
de.gameText: **Gemeinschaft.** Entdecke einen Zwerg, um die obersten 3 Karten von deinem Spieldeck aufzudecken. Nimm alle Karten der Freien Vï¿½lker in deine Hand und lege die ï¿½brigen ab.
de.loreText: Doch allein hier und sonst nirgends in der Welt wurde Moria-Silber gefunden, oder Wahr-Silber, wie manche es genannt haben: mithril ist der elbische Name.ï¿½

it.title: Ricchezze di Moria
it.gameText: **Compagnia:** Avvista un Nano per mostrare le prime 3 carte del tuo mazzo di gioco. Aggiungi alla mano tutte le carte dei Popoli Liberi mostrate e scarta il resto.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Codesto ï¿½ l'unico posto al mondo ove si trovi l'argento di Moria o, come l'hanno chiamato alcuni, il vero-argento: mithril ï¿½ il nome elfico.'ï¿½

es.title: Riqueza de Moria
es.gameText: **Comunidad:** Avista un Enano para revelar las 3 superiores cartas de tu mazo de robar. Coge todas las cartas de Gentes Libres reveladas en tu mano y descarta el resto.
es.loreText: ï¿½Pues este era el ï¿½nico sitio del mundo donde habï¿½a plata de Moria, o plata autentica como algunos la llamaban: mithril es el nombre ï¿½lfico.ï¿½

en.title: Ancient Enmity
en.gameText: **Skirmish:** Make an Elf strength +1. If a minion loses this skirmish to that Elf, that minionï¿½s owner discards 2 cards at random from hand.
en.loreText: Hard and bitter is the Elven hatred of Orcs, for they have lost many kinsmen to Orc savagery.

fr.title: Ancienne Haine
fr.gameText: **Combat :** Donnez +1 en force ï¿½ un Elfe. Si un sï¿½ide perd ce combat contre cet Elfe, le propriï¿½taire de ce sï¿½ide dï¿½fausse 2 cartes au hasard de sa main.
fr.loreText: Forte et profonde est la haine des Elfes vis-ï¿½-vis des Orques, car ils ont perdu de nombreux parents face ï¿½ la sauvagerie orque.

de.title: Uralte Feindschaft
de.gameText: **Kampf** Gib einem Elben Stï¿½rke +1. Wenn ein Diener den Kampf gegen diesen Elben verliert, legt der Spieler dieses Dieners 2 zufï¿½llig bestimmte Karten aus seiner Hand ab.
de.loreText: Groï¿½ und bitter ist der Hass der Elben auf die Orks, da sie viele Brï¿½der und Schwestern an sie verloren haben.

it.title: Antica Ostilitï¿½
it.gameText: **Schermaglia:** Aggiungi +1 alla forza di un Elfo. Se un servitore perde questa schermaglia contro quellï¿½Elfo, il possessore del servitore scarta 2 carte a caso dalla mano.
it.loreText: Forte e amaro ï¿½ l'odio degli Elfi per gli Orchi, poichï¿½ hanno perso molti consanguinei a causa della crudeltï¿½ degli Orchi.

es.title: Rencor Antiguo
es.gameText: **Escaramuza:** Da a un Elfo fuerza +1. Si un siervo pierde una escaramuza contra ese Elfo, el propietario de ese siervo descarta 2 cartas al azar de su mano.
es.loreText: Duro y amargo es el odio ï¿½lfico por los Orcos, ya que ellos han perdido un gran numero de parientes al salvajismo de los Orcos.

en.title: Asfaloth
en.gameText: Bearer must be an Elf. When played on Arwen, Asfalothï¿½s twilight cost is -2. While at a plains site, bearer is strength +2. Discard Asfaloth when at an underground site.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Noro lim, Asfaloth, noro lim!'ï¿½

fr.title: Asfaloth
fr.gameText: Le dï¿½tenteur doit ï¿½tre un Elfe. Lorsque jouï¿½ sur Arwen, le coï¿½t crï¿½pusculaire dï¿½Asfaloth est de -2. Tant quï¿½il est ï¿½ un site de plaines, le dï¿½tenteur a +2 en force. Dï¿½faussez Asfaloth ï¿½ un site **Souterrain.**
fr.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Noro lim, Asfaloth, noro lim!'ï¿½

de.title: Asfaloth
de.gameText: Muss auf einen Elben gespielt werden. Wenn Asfaloth auf Arwen gespielt wird, reduzieren sich die Kosten um 2. Auf einer Ebene erhï¿½ht sich die Stï¿½rke des Reiters um 2. Lege Asfaloth an einem unterirdischen Ort ab.
de.loreText: Noro lim, noro lim, Asfaloth!ï¿½

it.title: Asfaloth
it.gameText: Il possessore deve essere un Elfo. Quando ï¿½ giocato su Arwen, sottrai -2 al costo crepuscolo di Asfaloth. Finchï¿½ ï¿½ in un sito pianura, il possessore ha +2 alla forza. Scarta Asfaloth quando ï¿½ in un sito sotterraneo.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Noro lim, Asfaloth, noro lim!'ï¿½

es.title: Asfaloth
es.gameText: El portador debe ser un Elfo. Cuando es jugado en Arwen, el coste de penumbra de Asfaloth es -2. Cuando estï¿½ en un sitio de llanura, el portador es fuerza +2. Descarta a Asfaloth cuando este en un sitio **Subterrï¿½neo.**
es.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Noro Lim, Asfaloth, noro Lim!ï¿½

en.title: Border Defenses
en.gameText: **Skirmish:** Make an Elf strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing an archer).
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½None of the Orcs will ever return out of Lï¿½rien. And there will be many Elves hidden on the northern border before another night falls.'ï¿½

fr.title: Dï¿½fenses Frontaliï¿½res
fr.gameText: **Combat :** Donnez +2 en force (ou +4 sï¿½il combat un archer) ï¿½ un Elfe.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Aucun des Orques ne ressortira jamais de la Lï¿½rien. Et il y aura beaucoup d'Elfes cachï¿½s ï¿½ la lisiï¿½re nord avant la tombï¿½e de la nuit.'ï¿½

**Spell.**

**Spell.**

**Spell.**

es.loreText: ï¿½Losto Caradhras, sedho, hodo, nuitho i ruith.ï¿½

**Rï¿½ponse :** Si un compagnon est sur le point dï¿½ï¿½tre affaibli, dï¿½signez Gandalf pour ne placer aucun jeton pour cet affaiblissement.

en.title: Treachery Deeper Than You Know

**Spell.**

fr.gameText:
**Sort.**
**Compagnie :** Dï¿½signez Gandalf pour rï¿½vï¿½ler la main dï¿½un adversaire.

**Magia.**
**Compagnia:** Avvista Gandalf per far mostrare la mano a un avversario.

fr.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Repars, Sam. Tu ne sais pas nager. Je vais au Mordor seul.'ï¿½

de.title: Verzweifelte Massnahmen
de.gameText: **Manï¿½ver:** Entdecke einen <symbol>sauron</symbol> Ork und entferne 1 Lastmarke, um den Freie Vï¿½lker Spieler zu zwingen, die obersten 5 Karten von seinem Spieldeck abzulegen.
de.loreText: Geh zurï¿½ck, Sam. Ich werde alleine nach Mordor gehen. Du kannst nicht schwimmen.ï¿½

it.title: Misure Disperate
it.gameText: **Manovra:** Avvista un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol> e rimuovi un segnalino fardello per far scartare al giocatore dei Popoli Liberi le prime 5 carte del suo mazzo di gioco.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Torna indietro, Sam. Non puoi nuotare. Andrï¿½ a Mordor da solo.'ï¿½

es.title: Medidas Desesperadas
es.gameText: **Maniobra:** Avista un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol> y quita una carga para hacer que el jugador de Gentes Libres descarte las 5 cartas superiores de su mazo de robar.
es.loreText: ï¿½Regresa, Sam. No puedes nadar. Voy a Mordor solo.ï¿½

en.title: Enduring Evil
en.gameText: **Skirmish:** Spot X burdens to make a character skirmishing a <symbol>sauron</symbol> Orc strength -X.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½The Dark Tower was broken, but its foundations were not removed; for they were made with the power of the Ring, and while it remains they will endure.'ï¿½

fr.title: Mal Persistant
fr.gameText: **Combat :** Dï¿½signez X points-fardeau pour donner ï¿½ un personnage combattant un Orque <symbol>sauron</symbol> -X en force.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½La Tour Sombre ï¿½tait dï¿½molie, mais les fondations n'en ï¿½taient pas effacï¿½es ; car elles avaient ï¿½tï¿½ faites par le pouvoir de l'Anneau et tant qu'il restera, elles demeureront.'ï¿½

de.title: Andauerndes ï¿½bel
de.gameText: **Kampf** Entdecke X Lastmarken, um einem Charakter, der gegen einen <symbol>sauron</symbol> Ork kï¿½mpft, Stï¿½rke -X zu geben.
de.loreText: Der Schwarze Turm war geschleift, doch seine Grundmauern standen noch; denn sie waren mit der Macht des Ringes gebaut worden, und solange er da ist, bleiben sie erhalten.ï¿½

it.title: Male Durevole
it.gameText: **Schermaglia:** Avvista X segnalini fardello per sottrarre -X alla forza di un personaggio che stia schermagliando con un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol>.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½La Torre Oscura fu demolita, ma le sue fondamenta rimasero perchï¿½ furono costruite col potere dell'Anello e scompariranno soltanto con esso.'ï¿½

es.title: Mal Duradero
es.gameText: **Escaramuza:** Avista X cargas para hacer que un personaje en una escaramuza contra un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol> sea fuerza -X.
es.loreText: ï¿½La Torre Oscura fue demolida, pero quedaron los cimientos; pues habï¿½an sido puestos con el poder del Anillo, y mientras haya Anillo nada podrï¿½ desenterrarlos.ï¿½

en.title: Enheartened Foe
en.gameText: **Response:** If a <symbol>sauron</symbol> Orc wins a skirmish, make that Orc **fierce** until the regroup phase.
en.loreText: Orcs feed on their own success. The greater their exploits in battle, the greater their confidence grows.

fr.title: Ennemi sans Pitiï¿½
fr.gameText: **Rï¿½ponse :** Si un Orque <symbol>sauron</symbol> remporte un combat, rendez cet Orque **acharnï¿½** jusquï¿½ï¿½ la phase de ralliement.
fr.loreText: Les Orques se nourrissent de leurs propres succï¿½s. Plus ils rï¿½ussissent dans la bataille, plus leur confiance croï¿½t.

de.title: Beherzter Feind
de.gameText: **Reaktion:** Mache einen <symbol>sauron</symbol> Ork bis zur Sammelphase **erbittert**, wenn dieser einen Kampf gewinnt.
de.loreText: Das Selbstbewusstsein der Orks wï¿½chst mit ihren Erfolgen. Je mehr Erfolg, desto grï¿½ï¿½er die Taten.

it.title: Nemico Rincuorato
it.gameText: **Risposta:** Se un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol> vince una schermaglia, rendi quellï¿½Orco **Feroce** fino alla fase di raccolta.
it.loreText: Gli Orchi sono nutriti dai loro stessi successi. Piï¿½ sono grandi le loro imprese in battaglia, piï¿½ cresce la loro baldanza.

es.title: Enemigo Embravecido
es.gameText: **Respuesta:** Si un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol> gana una escaramuza, da a ese Orco **fiero** hasta la fase de reagrupaciï¿½n.
es.loreText: Los Orcos se alimentan en su propio triunfo. Cuanto mï¿½s grandes sus proezas en la batalla, mï¿½s grande crece su confianza.

en.title: Forces of Mordor
en.gameText: **Shadow:** Spot X <symbol>sauron</symbol> minions to add <symbol>twilightX</symbol>.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½....the Dark Lord is not without allies. The Easterlings and Haradrim now pay tribute to Mordor.'ï¿½

fr.title: Ressources du Mordor
fr.gameText: Ombre : Dï¿½signez X sï¿½ides <symbol>sauron</symbol> pour ajouter <symbol>twilightX</symbol>.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½....le Seigneur Tï¿½nï¿½breux n'est pas sans alliï¿½s. Ceux de l'Est et les Haradrim paient maintenant un tribut au Mordor.'ï¿½

de.title: Die Truppen von Mordor
de.gameText: **Schatten:** Entdecke X <symbol>sauron</symbol> Diener, um den Einfluss um <symbol>twilightX</symbol> zu erhï¿½hen.
de.loreText: ...der dunkle Herrscher hat Verbï¿½ndete. Die Ostlinge und Haradrim zollen Mordor nun Tribut.ï¿½

it.title: Forze di Mordor
it.gameText: **Ombra:** Avvista X servitori <symbol>sauron</symbol> per aggiungere <symbol>twilightX</symbol>.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½....il Signore Oscuro non ï¿½ senza alleati. Gli Esterling e gli Haradrim ora pagano il tributo a Mordor.'ï¿½

es.title: Fuerzas de Mordor
es.gameText: **Sombra:** Avista X siervos <symbol>sauron</symbol> para aï¿½adir <symbol>twilightX</symbol>.
es.loreText: ï¿½... El Seï¿½or Oscuro no esta sin aliados. Los Hombres del este y los Haradrim ahora pagan tributo a Mordor.ï¿½

en.title: Gleaming Spires Will Crumble
en.gameText:
Each <symbol>sauron</symbol> Orc skirmishing a <symbol>gondor</symbol> character is strength +2. 
Discard this condition if your <symbol>sauron</symbol> Orc loses a skirmish.
en.loreText: Gondor has long been a target for the wrath of Sauron the Great.

fr.title: Les Tours Rayonnantes s'ï¿½crouleront
fr.gameText: Chaque Orque <symbol>sauron</symbol> combattant un personnage <symbol>gondor</symbol> a +2 en force. Dï¿½faussez cette situation si votre Orque <symbol>sauron</symbol> perd un combat.
fr.loreText: Le Gondor a longtemps ï¿½tï¿½ la cible du courroux de Sauron le Grand.

de.title: Die glï¿½nzenden Tï¿½rme werden zerfallen
de.gameText: Spiele diese Karte in deinen Unterstï¿½tzungs-bereich. Alle <symbol>sauron</symbol> Orks, die gegen einen <symbol>gondor</symbol> Charakter kï¿½mpfen, erhalten Stï¿½rke +2. Lege diesen Effekt ab, wenn einer deiner <symbol>sauron</symbol> Orks einen Kampf verliert.
de.loreText: Gondor ist schon lange das Ziel des Hasses von Sauron, dem Groï¿½en.

it.title: Scintillanti Guglie Crolleranno
it.gameText: Ogni Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol> che stia schermagliando con un personaggio <symbol>gondor</symbol> aggiunge +2 alla forza. Scarta questa condizione se un tuo Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol> perde una schermaglia.
it.loreText: Gondor ï¿½ stata da lungo tempo il bersaglio della collera di Sauron il Grande.

es.title: Relucientes Espiras Se Derrumbaran
es.gameText: Cada Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol> en una escaramuza contra un personaje <symbol>gondor</symbol> es fuerza +2. Descarta esta condiciï¿½n si tu Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol> pierde una escaramuza.
es.loreText: Gondor ha sido durante mucho el objetivo de la ira de Sauron el Grande.

en.title: Hate
en.gameText: **Maneuver:** Exert a <symbol>sauron</symbol> Orc to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
en.loreText: Orcs are filled with hatred not only for their foes, but for all that lives.

fr.title: Haine
fr.gameText: **Manï¿½uvre :** Affaiblissez un Orque <symbol>sauron</symbol> pour blesser un compagnon (exceptï¿½ le Porteur de lï¿½Anneau).
fr.loreText: Les Orques sont remplis de haine non seulement pour leurs ennemis, mais pour tout ce qui vit.

de.title: Hass
de.gameText: **Manï¿½ver:** Strenge einen <symbol>sauron</symbol> Ork an, um einen Gefï¿½hrten (ausser dem Ringtrï¿½ger) zu verwunden.
de.loreText: Orks hassen nicht nur ihre Feinde, sondern alles was lebt.

it.title: Odio
it.gameText: **Manovra:** Sforza un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol> per ferire un compagno (eccetto il Portatore dellï¿½Anello).
it.loreText: Gli Orchi sono pieni d'odio non solo per i loro nemici, ma per tutto ciï¿½ che vive.

es.title: Odio
es.gameText: **Maniobra:** Esfuerza un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol> para herir un compaï¿½ero (excepto el Portador del Anillo).
es.loreText: Los Orcos estï¿½n llenos de odio no solo por sus enemigos, sino por todo lo que vive.

en.title: A Host Avails Little
en.gameText:
**Search.**  
**Maneuver:** Spot a <symbol>sauron</symbol> Orc and 6 companions to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer). Do this once for each companion over 5.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Had I a host of Elves in armour of the Elder Days, it would avail little....'ï¿½

fr.title: Une Phalange Accomplit Peu
fr.gameText:
**Recherche.**
**Manï¿½uvre :** Dï¿½signez un Orque <symbol>sauron</symbol> et 6 compagnons pour blesser un compagnon (exceptï¿½ le Porteur de lï¿½Anneau). Faites-le une fois pour chaque compagnon au delï¿½ de 5.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Eussï¿½-je une phalange d'Elfes en armes des Anciens Jours que cela servirait seulement ï¿½ ï¿½veiller la puissance du Mordor.'ï¿½

de.title: Ein Heer wï¿½rde mir auch nichts nï¿½tzen
de.gameText: **Suche.** **Manï¿½ver:** Entdecke einen <symbol>sauron</symbol> Ork und 6 Gefï¿½hrten, um einen Gefï¿½hrten (ausser dem Ringtrï¿½ger) zu verwunden. Mache dies einmal fï¿½r jeden Gefï¿½hrten ï¿½ber 5.
de.loreText: Hï¿½tte ich eine bewaffnete Streitmacht der Elben wie in der Altvorderenzeit, so wï¿½rde sie wenig nutzen...ï¿½

it.title: Un Esercito Serve a Poco
it.gameText:
**Ricerca.**
**Manovra:** Avvista un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol> e 6 compagni per ferire un compagno (eccetto il Portatore dellï¿½Anello). Fai questo una volta per ogni compagno oltre il quinto.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Anche se disponessi ancora di una schiera di Elfi muniti di armatura come nei Tempi Remoti, potrebbe fare ben poco.'ï¿½

es.title: Una Hueste Nos Servirï¿½a de Poco
es.gameText: **Bï¿½squeda.** **Maniobra:** Avista un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol> y 6 compaï¿½eros para herir un compaï¿½ero (excepto el Portador del Anillo). Haz esto una vez por cada compaï¿½ero por encima de 5.
es.loreText: ï¿½Aunque contï¿½ramos con una hueste de Elfos con armas de los Dï¿½as Antiguos, solo conseguirï¿½amos despertar el poder de Mordor.ï¿½

en.title: The Irresistible Shadow
en.gameText:
To play, exert a <symbol>sauron</symbol> Orc.  
If you can spot 5 burdens and the Free Peoples player has no cards in his or her draw deck, the Ring-bearer is corrupted.
en.loreText: ï¿½Once more the desire to slip on the Ring came over Frodo; but this time it was stronger than before.ï¿½

fr.title: L'Ombre Irrï¿½sistible
fr.gameText: Pour jouer, affaiblissez un Orque <symbol>sauron</symbol>. Si vous pouvez dï¿½signer 5 points-fardeau et que le joueur des Peuples Libres nï¿½a pas de carte dans sa pioche, le Porteur de lï¿½Anneau est corrompu.
fr.loreText: ï¿½Une fois de plus, le dï¿½sir de glisser l'Anneau ï¿½ son doigt s'empara de Frodon ; mais cette fois, il ï¿½tait plus fort qu'auparavant.ï¿½

de.title: Unaufhaltsamer Schatten
de.gameText: Strenge einen <symbol>sauron</symbol> Ork an, um diese Karte in deinen Unterstï¿½tzungsbereich zu spielen. Wenn du 5 Lastmarken entdecken kannst und der Freie Vï¿½lker Spieler keine Karten mehr in seinem Spieldeck hat, erliegt der Ringtrï¿½ger der Versuchung des Rings.
de.loreText: Wieder wurde Frodo von dem Wunsch befallen, den Ring aufzustreifen, aber diesmal stï¿½rker als vorher.

it.title: L'Irresistibile Ombra
it.gameText: Per giocarla, sforza un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol>. Se puoi avvistare 5 segnalini fardello e il giocatore dei Popoli Liberi non ha carte nel suo mazzo di gioco, il Portatore dellï¿½Anello ï¿½ corrotto.
it.loreText: ï¿½Il desiderio di infilarsi l'Anello s'impadronï¿½ di Frodo; ma questa volta con molta piï¿½ forza.ï¿½

es.title: La Sombra Irresistible
es.gameText: Para jugarla, esfuerza un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol>. Si puedes avistar 5 cargas y el jugador de Gentes Libres no tiene cartas en su mazo de robar, el Portador del Anillo se corrompe.
es.loreText: ï¿½Una vez mas Frodo sintiï¿½ el deseo de ponerse el Anillo, y el deseo era mas fuerte que nunca.ï¿½

en.title: Journey Into Danger
en.gameText:
**Search.**  To play, exert a <symbol>sauron</symbol> Orc.   
While you can spot 5 companions, each companionï¿½s twilight cost is +2.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½I do not foretell, for all foretelling is now vain: on the one hand lies darkness, on the other only hope.'ï¿½

fr.title: Voyage au C*ur du Danger
fr.gameText: **Recherche.** Pour jouer, affaiblissez un Orque <symbol>sauron</symbol>. Tant que vous pouvez dï¿½signer 5 compagnons, le coï¿½t crï¿½pusculaire de chaque compagnon est de +2.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Je ne prï¿½dis rien, car toute prï¿½diction serait ï¿½ prï¿½sent vaine: d'une part il y a les tï¿½nï¿½bres, et de l'autre seulement de l'espoir.'ï¿½

de.title: Eine Reise voller Gefahren
de.gameText: **Suche.** Strenge einen <symbol>sauron</symbol> Ork an, um diese Karte in deinen Unterstï¿½tzungsbereich zu spielen. Solange du 5 Gefï¿½hrten entdecken kannst, erhï¿½hen sich die Zwielichtkosten der Gefï¿½hrten um 2.
de.loreText: Ich weissage nicht, denn alles Weissagen ist jetzt vergebens: auf der einen Seite liegt Dunkelheit und auf der anderen nur Hoffnung.ï¿½

it.title: Viaggio nel Pericolo
it.gameText: **Ricerca.** Per giocarla, sforza un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol>. Finchï¿½ puoi avvistare 5 compagni, il costo crepuscolo di ogni compagno ï¿½ +2.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Non predico il futuro, perchï¿½ ogni profezia ï¿½ vana: da un lato vi ï¿½ l'oscuritï¿½, e dall'altro solo speranza.'ï¿½

es.title: Viaje Hacia El Peligro
es.gameText: **Bï¿½squeda.** Para jugarla, esfuerza un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol>. Mientras puedas avistar 5 compaï¿½eros, el coste de penumbra de cada compaï¿½ero es +2.
es.loreText: ï¿½No profetizo nada, pues toda profecï¿½a es vana ahora; de un lado hay oscuridad y del otro lado nada mas que esperanza.ï¿½

en.title: Mordor Enraged
en.gameText:
Plays on a <symbol>sauron</symbol> minion.  
**Shadow:** Exert bearer to add <symbol>twilight1</symbol> for each archer companion.
en.loreText: The armies of Elendil and Gil-galad inflamed Sauron's anger and hatred.

fr.title: Mordor Exaspï¿½rï¿½
fr.gameText: Jouable sur un sï¿½ide <symbol>sauron</symbol>. Ombre : Affaiblissez le dï¿½tenteur pour ajouter <symbol>twilight1</symbol> pour chaque compagnon **Archer.**
fr.loreText: Les armï¿½es d'Elendil et de Gil-galad enflammï¿½rent la colï¿½re de Sauron et sa haine.

de.title: Mordor in Aufruhr
de.gameText: Wird auf einen <symbol>sauron</symbol> Diener gespielt. **Schatten:** Strenge den Trï¿½ger an, um den Einfluss um <symbol>twilight1</symbol> fï¿½r jeden Bogenschï¿½tzen unter den Gefï¿½hrten zu erhï¿½hen.
de.loreText: Die Armeen von Elendil und Gil-galad entfachten Saurons Zorn und Hass.

it.title: Furia di Mordor
it.gameText: Giocala su un servitore <symbol>sauron</symbol>. **Ombra:** Sforza il possessore per aggiungere <symbol>twilight1</symbol> per ogni arciere compagno.
it.loreText: Le armate di Elendil e Gil-Galad accesero l'ira e l'odio di Sauron.

es.title: Mordor Enfurecido
es.gameText: Se juega en un siervo <symbol>sauron</symbol> **Sombra:** Esfuerza al portador para aï¿½adir <symbol>twilight1</symbol> por cada compaï¿½ero **arquero.**
es.loreText: Los ejï¿½rcitos de Elendil y Gil-Galad enardecieron la ira y el odio de Sauron.

en.title: Mordor's Strength
en.gameText: **Skirmish:** Exert a <symbol>sauron</symbol> Orc to wound a character he is skirmishing.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½It should have ended that day, but evil was allowed to endure.'ï¿½

fr.title: Force de Mordor
fr.gameText: **Combat :** Affaiblissez un Orque <symbol>sauron</symbol> pour blesser un personage quï¿½il combat.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Cela aurait dï¿½ se terminer ce jour, mais il a ï¿½tï¿½ permis au Mal de persister.'ï¿½

de.title: Mordors Stï¿½rke
de.gameText: **Kampf** Strenge einen <symbol>sauron</symbol> Ork an, um den Charakter, den er bekï¿½mpft, zu verwunden.
de.loreText: Es hï¿½tte damals enden sollen, aber es wurde dem Bï¿½sen erlaubt, weiterzubestehen.ï¿½

it.title: Forza di Mordor
it.gameText: **Schermaglia:** Sforza un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol> per ferire un personaggio contro cui stia schermagliando.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Avrebbe dovuto essere concluso quel giorno, ma al male ï¿½ stato permesso di resistere.'ï¿½

es.title: La Fuerza de Mordor
es.gameText: **Escaramuza:** Esfuerza un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol> para herir un personaje con el que este en una escaramuza.
es.loreText: ï¿½Tendrï¿½a que haber acabado ese dï¿½a, pero al mal se le permitiï¿½ perdurar.ï¿½

en.title: Morgul Skirmisher
en.gameText: **Maneuver:** Remove <symbol>twilight3</symbol> to exert a Hobbit (except the Ring-bearer).
en.loreText: The Orcs of Mordor, heartened by the promise of blood and plunder, are dangerous foes in battle.

fr.title: Combattant de Morgul
fr.gameText: **Manï¿½uvre :** Retirez <symbol>twilight3</symbol> pour affaiblir un Hobbit (exceptï¿½ le Porteur de lï¿½Anneau).
fr.loreText: Les Orques du Mordor, portï¿½s par la promesse de sang et de butin, sont de dangereux ennemis dans la bataille.

de.title: Morgul Plï¿½nkler
de.gameText: **Manï¿½ver:** Verringere den Einfluss um <symbol>twilight3</symbol>, um einen Hobbit (ausser dem Ringtrï¿½ger) anzustrengen.
de.loreText: Die Orks von Mordor, durch den Gedanken an Blutvergiessen und Beute beflï¿½gelt, sind gefï¿½hrliche Gegner im Kampf.

it.title: Schermagliatore
it.subtitle: Orco di Morgul
it.gameText: **Manovra:** Rimuovi <symbol>twilight3</symbol> per sforzare un Hobbit (eccetto il Portatore dellï¿½Anello). Gli Orchi di Mordor, incoraggiati dalla promessa di sangue e bottino, sono nemici pericolosi in battaglia.

es.title: Hostigador de Morgul
es.gameText: **Maniobra:** Quita <symbol>twilight3</symbol> para esforzar un Hobbit (excepto el Portador del Anillo).
es.loreText: Los Orcos de Mordor, embravecidos por la promesa de sangre y botï¿½n, son enemigos peligrosos en la batalla.

en.title: Morgul Skulker
en.gameText: When you play this minion, you may shuffle up to 2 <symbol>wraith</symbol> cards from your discard pile into your draw deck.
en.loreText: Sly servants of the Ringwraiths of Morgul Vale, Morgul Orcs are alert to the desires of their masters.

fr.title: Maraudeur de Morgul
fr.gameText: Quand vous jouez ce sï¿½ide, vous pouvez mï¿½langer juquï¿½ï¿½ 2 cartes <symbol>wraith</symbol> de votre pile de dï¿½fausse dans votre pioche.
fr.loreText: Serviteurs sournois des Spectres de l'Anneau de la Vallï¿½e de Morgul, les Orques de Morgul sont soucieux des dï¿½sirs de leurs maï¿½tres.

de.title: Morgul Schleicher
de.gameText: Wenn du diesen Diener spielst, darfst du bis zu 2 <symbol>wraith</symbol> Karten aus deinem Ablagestapel in dein Spieldeck mischen.
de.loreText: Die Orks von Minas Morgul, durchtriebene Diener der Ringgeister, sind besonders aufmerksam, was die Wï¿½nsche ihrer Meister angeht.

it.title: Esploratore
it.subtitle: Orco di Morgul
it.gameText: Quando giochi questo servitore, puoi mescolare fino a 2 carte <symbol>wraith</symbol> dalla tua pila degli scarti nel tuo mazzo di gioco.
it.loreText: Scaltri servi dello Spettro dell'Anello della Valle di Morgul, gli Orchi di Morgul sono attenti ai desideri dei loro padroni.

es.title: Acechador de Morgul
es.gameText: Cuando juegas este siervo, puedes barajar hasta 2 cartas <symbol>wraith</symbol> de tu pila de descartes en tu mazo de robar.
es.loreText: Astutos servidores de los Espectros del Anillo del Valle de Morgul, los Orcos de Morgul estï¿½n alerta a los deseos de sus amos.

en.title: Morgul Warden
en.gameText: For each other <symbol>sauron</symbol> Orc you can spot, Morgul Warden is strength +1.
en.loreText: With blind devotion, the Orcs of Mordor follow orders issued from the Dark Tower.

fr.title: Gardien de Morgul
fr.gameText: Pour chaque autre Orque <symbol>sauron</symbol> que vous pouvez dï¿½signer, le Gardien de Morgul a +1 en force.
fr.loreText: Avec une dï¿½votion aveugle, les Orques du Mordor suivent les ordres venus de la Tour Sombre.

de.title: Morgul Wï¿½chter
de.gameText: Fï¿½r jeden weiteren <symbol>sauron</symbol> Ork, den du entdecken kannst, erhï¿½lt der Morgul Wï¿½chter Stï¿½rke +1.
de.loreText: Mit blinder Hingabe folgen die Orks aus Mordor den Befehlen aus dem Dunklen Turm.

it.title: Guardiano di Morgul
it.gameText: Per ogni altro Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol> che puoi avvistare, Guardiano di Morgul aggiunge +1 alla forza.
it.loreText: Con devozione cieca, gli Orchi di Mordor seguono gli ordini emanati dalla Torre Oscura.

es.title: Vigilante de Morgul
es.gameText: Por cada otro Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol> que puedas avistar, el Vigilante de Morgul es fuerza +1.
es.loreText: Con ciega devociï¿½n, los Orcos de Mordor siguen las ordenes de la Torre Oscura.

en.title: The Number Must Be Few

it.title: Difese di Sauron

it.loreText: I servi di Sauron sono ovunque. Poche strade sfuggono allo sguardo dell'Occhio Senza Palpebre.

es.title: Las Defensas de Sauron
es.gameText: Para jugarla, esfuerza un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol>. Mientras haya 3 o mï¿½s compaï¿½eros en la pila de muertos, el lï¿½mite de movimiento para este turno es -1 (hasta un mï¿½nimo de 1).
es.loreText: Los siervos de Sauron estï¿½n en todas partes. Pocos caminos escapan de la mirada del Ojo sin Pï¿½rpado.

en.title: Seeking It Always
en.gameText:
**Search.**   
**Response:** If a stealth event is played, exert a <symbol>sauron</symbol> tracker to cancel that event.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½...the only measure that he knows is desire, desire for power; and so he judges all hearts.'ï¿½

fr.title: Toujours ï¿½ sa Recherche
fr.gameText: **Recherche.** **Rï¿½ponse :** Si un ï¿½vï¿½nement de dissimulation est jouï¿½, affaiblissez un traqueur <symbol>sauron</symbol> pour annuler cet ï¿½vï¿½nement.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½...la seule mesure qu'il connaisse est le dï¿½sir, le dï¿½sir du pouvoir ; et c'est ainsi qu'il juge tous les c*urs.'ï¿½

de.title: Stetig auf der Suche
de.gameText: **Suche.** **Reaktion:** Wenn ein Heimlichkeitsereignis gespielt wird, strenge einen <symbol>sauron</symbol> Spurenleser an, um dieses Ereignis zu verhindern.
de.loreText: Doch der einzige Maï¿½stab, den er kennt, ist Begehren, das Streben nach Macht, und danach beurteilt er alle Herzen.ï¿½

it.title: Cercandolo Sempre
it.gameText:
**Ricerca.** Giocala nella tua area di supporto.
**Risposta:** Se un evento Segretezza ï¿½ giocato, sforza un inseguitore <symbol>sauron</symbol> per cancellare quellï¿½evento.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½...l'unica misura che conosce ï¿½ il desiderio, desiderio di potere, ed egli giudica tutti i cuori alla stessa stregua.'ï¿½

es.title: Siempre Buscï¿½ndolo
es.gameText: **Bï¿½squeda.** **Respuesta:** Si se juega un evento de sigilo, esfuerza un rastreador <symbol>sauron</symbol> para cancelar ese evento.
es.loreText: ï¿½Pero la ï¿½nica medida que conoce es el deseo, deseo de poder, y asï¿½ juzga todos los corazones.ï¿½

en.title: Seeking Its Master
en.gameText: **Shadow:** Exert a <symbol>sauron</symbol> Orc and remove <symbol>twilight2</symbol> to draw a card.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½This at least is plain: the evil of the Ring is already at work even in the Company, and the Ring must leave them before it does more harm.'ï¿½

fr.title: ï¿½ la Recherche de son Maï¿½tre
fr.gameText: Ombre : Affaiblissez un Orque <symbol>sauron</symbol> et retirez <symbol>twilight2</symbol> pour piocher une carte.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Une chose au moins est claire: la nocivitï¿½ de l'Anneau est dï¿½jï¿½ ï¿½ l'*uvre mï¿½me dans la compagnie, et il doit la quitter avant de commettre davantage de mï¿½faits.'ï¿½

de.title: Sehnsucht nach seinem Herrn
de.gameText: Spiele diese Karte in deinen Unterstï¿½tzungs-bereich. **Schatten:** Strenge einen <symbol>sauron</symbol> Ork an und verringere den Einfluss um <symbol>twilight2</symbol>, um eine Karte zu ziehen.
de.loreText: Das wenigstens ist klar: das Bï¿½se des Rings wirkt sich sogar schon auf den Bund aus, und der Ring muss die Gefï¿½hrten verlassen, ehe er mehr Unheil stiftet.ï¿½

it.title: Cercando il Suo Padrone
it.gameText: **Ombra:** Sforza un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol> e rimuovi <symbol>twilight2</symbol> per pescare una carta.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Una cosa perlomeno ï¿½ palese: la malvagitï¿½ dell'Anello sta incominciando a intaccare persino l'integritï¿½ della Compagnia; ï¿½ indispensabile che l'Anello si allontani da loro, prima che la situazione peggiori.'ï¿½

es.title: Buscando a Su Amo
es.gameText: **Sombra:** Esfuerza un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol> y quita <symbol>twilight2</symbol> para robar una carta.
es.loreText: ï¿½Esto al menos ya esta claro: la malignidad del Anillo ya esta operando, aun en la Compaï¿½ï¿½a, y antes que haga mas dalo hay que llevarlo lejos.ï¿½

en.title: Shadow's Reach
en.gameText: **Shadow:** Exert a <symbol>sauron</symbol> Orc to discard a Free Peoples condition.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Is it secret? Is it safe?'ï¿½

fr.title: L'Emprise de l'Ombre
fr.gameText: Ombre : Affaiblissez un Orque <symbol>sauron</symbol> pour dï¿½fausser une situation des Peuples Libres.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Est-il cachï¿½ ? Est-il en sï¿½curitï¿½ ?'ï¿½

de.title: Der lange Arm des Schattens
de.gameText: **Schatten:** Strenge einen <symbol>sauron</symbol> Ork an, um einen Freie Vï¿½lker Effekt abzulegen.
de.loreText: Ist er versteckt? Ist er sicher?ï¿½

it.title: Portata dell'Ombra
it.gameText: **Ombra:** Sforza un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol> per scartare una condizione dei Popoli Liberi.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½ï¿½ nascosto? ï¿½ in salvo?'ï¿½

es.title: El Alcance de La Sombra
es.gameText: **Sombra:** Esfuerza un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol> para descartar una condiciï¿½n de Gentes Libres.
es.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Esta en un lugar secreto? ï¿½Esta seguro?ï¿½

en.title: Strength Born of Fear
en.gameText: **Skirmish:** Remove <symbol>twilight3</symbol> to make a <symbol>sauron</symbol> Orc strength +1.
en.loreText: Fear of death in Barad-dï¿½r's dungeons spurs Mordor's servants to even greater savagery.

fr.title: Force Nï¿½e de la Peur
fr.gameText: **Combat :** Retirez <symbol>twilight3</symbol> pour donner ï¿½ un Orque <symbol>sauron</symbol> +1 en force.
fr.loreText: La peur de mourir dans les fosses de Barad-dï¿½r pousse les serviteurs du Mordor ï¿½ la plus grande sauvagerie.

de.title: Angst verleiht Kraft
de.gameText: Spiele diese Karte in deinen Unterstï¿½tzungs-bereich. **Kampf** Verringere den Einfluss um <symbol>twilight3</symbol>, um einem <symbol>sauron</symbol> Ork Stï¿½rke +1 zu geben.
de.loreText: Die Furcht vor dem Tod in den Verliesen Barad-dï¿½rs spornt Mordors Diener zu noch grï¿½ï¿½erer Wildheit an.

it.title: Forza Nata dalla Paura
it.gameText: **Schermaglia:** Rimuovi <symbol>twilight3</symbol> per aggiungere +1 alla forza di un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol>.
it.loreText: La paura della morte nei sotterranei di Barad-dï¿½r sprona i servi di Mordor a crudeltï¿½ persino piï¿½ grandi.

es.title: Fuerza Nacida del Miedo
es.gameText: **Escaramuza:** Quita <symbol>twilight3</symbol> para dar fuerza +1 a un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol>.
es.loreText: El miedo a la muerte en los calabozos de Barad-dï¿½r incita a los servidores de mordor a mayor salvajismo.

en.title: Thin and Stretched
en.gameText:
To play, exert a <symbol>sauron</symbol> Orc. Plays on the Ring-bearer.  
Add a burden at the end of each turn during which bearer was not assigned to a skirmish (and another companion was).
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½I am old, Gandalf. I don't look it....'ï¿½

fr.title: Maigre et Dï¿½tirï¿½
fr.gameText:
Pour jouer, affaiblissez un Orque <symbol>sauron</symbol>. Jouable sur le Porteur de lï¿½Anneau.
Ajoutez un point-fardeau ï¿½ la fin de chaque tour au cours duquel le dï¿½tenteur nï¿½a pas ï¿½tï¿½ affectï¿½ ï¿½ un combat (alors quï¿½un autre compagnon lï¿½a ï¿½tï¿½).
fr.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Je suis vieux, Gandalf. Je ne le semble pas....'ï¿½

de.title: Dï¿½nn und ausgemergelt
de.gameText: Strenge einen <symbol>sauron</symbol> Ork an, um diese Karte auf den Ringtrï¿½ger zu spielen. Lege eine Lastmarke am Ende jedes Spielzuges auf den Ringtrï¿½ger, wenn ein anderer Gefï¿½hrte einem Kampf zugewiesen wurde und er nicht.
de.loreText: Ich bin alt, Gandalf. Man sieht es mir nicht an...ï¿½

it.title: Magro e Teso
it.gameText:
Per giocarla, sforza un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol>. Giocala sul Portatore dellï¿½Anello.
Aggiungi un segnalino fardello alla fine di ogni turno in cui il possessore non ï¿½ stato assegnato a una schermaglia (e lo ï¿½ stato un altro compagno).
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Sono vecchio, Gandalf. Non dimostro i miei anni....'ï¿½

es.title: Flaco y Estirado
es.gameText: Para jugarla, esfuerza un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol>. Se juega sobre el Portador del Anillo. Aï¿½ade una carga al final de cada turno en el que Portador del Anillo no fue asignado a una escaramuza (y otro compaï¿½ero lo fue).
es.loreText: ï¿½Estoy viejo, Gandalf; no lo parezco...ï¿½

en.title: Tower Lieutenant
en.gameText: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player discards 2 cards at random from hand.
en.loreText: Sauron shows favour to those in his dungeons with the ambition to squeeze the information he needs from those caught spying out his borders.

fr.title: Lieutenant de la Tour
fr.gameText: Chaque fois que ce sï¿½ide remporte un combat, le joueur des Peuples Libres dï¿½fausse 2 cartes au hasard de sa main.
fr.loreText: Sauron se montre favorable envers ceux dans ses fosses dont l'ambition est d'extorquer les informations dont il a besoin ï¿½ ceux pris ï¿½ explorer ses frontiï¿½res.

de.title: Leutnant des Turms
de.gameText: Jedesmal, wenn dieser Diener einen Kampf gewinnt, muss der Freie Vï¿½lker Spieler 2 zufï¿½llig bestimmte Karten aus seiner Hand ablegen.
de.loreText: Saurons Wohlwollen gilt denen in seinen Verliesen, die den Ehrgeiz haben, den an den Grenzen seines Reichs gefangenen Spionen Informationen zu entlocken.

it.title: Luogotenente
it.subtitle: Orco della Torre
it.gameText: Ogni volta che questo servitore vince una schermaglia, il giocatore dei Popoli Liberi scarta 2 carte a caso dalla mano.
it.loreText: Sauron mostra benevolenza verso quelli con l'ambizione di estorcere, nei suoi sotterranei, le informazioni di cui ha bisogno da chi ï¿½ stato sorpreso a spiare fuori dai suoi confini.

es.title: Teniente de La Torre
es.gameText: Cada vez que este siervo gana una escaramuza, el jugador de Gentes Libres descarta 2 cartas al azar de su mano.
es.loreText: Sauron demuestra su favor hacia aquellos en sus mazmorras con la ambiciï¿½n de exprimir la informaciï¿½n que ï¿½l necesita de esos espï¿½as atrapados en sus fronteras.

en.title: Under the Watching Eye
en.gameText:
**Search.** To play, exert a <symbol>sauron</symbol> tracker.   
Each time the fellowship moves, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion.
en.loreText: What the Lidless Eye of Sauron does not see, his countless minions observe and report.

fr.title: Sous le Regard Vigilant
fr.gameText: **Recherche.** Pour jouer, affaiblissez un traqueur <symbol>sauron</symbol>. Chaque fois que la compagnie se dï¿½place, le joueur des Peuples Libres doit affaiblir un compagnon.
fr.loreText: Ce que l'*il sans Paupiï¿½re de Sauron ne voit pas, ses sï¿½ides innombrables l'observent et le rapportent.

de.title: Unter wachsamenen Blicken
de.gameText: **Suche.** Strenge einen <symbol>sauron</symbol> Spurenleser an, um diese Karte in deinen Unterstï¿½tzungsbereich zu spielen. Jedesmal, wenn sich die Gemeinschaft bewegt, muss der Freie Vï¿½lker Spieler einen Gefï¿½hrten anstrengen.
de.loreText: Was den Blicken des Lidlosen Auges entgeht, wird von seinen zahllosen Dienern beobachtet und berichtet.

it.title: Sotto lo Sguardo dell'Occhio
it.gameText: **Ricerca.** Per giocarla, sforza un inseguitore <symbol>sauron</symbol>. Ogni volta che la Compagnia si muove, il giocatore dei Popoli Liberi deve sforzare un compagno.
it.loreText: Quello che l'Occhio Senza Palpebre di Sauron non vede, i suoi innumerevoli servi osservano e riferiscono.

es.title: Bajo El Ojo Vigilante
es.gameText: **Bï¿½squeda.** Para jugarla, esfuerza un rastreador <symbol>sauron</symbol>. Cada vez que la comunidad se mueve, el jugador de Gentes Libres debe esforzar un compaï¿½ero.
es.loreText: Lo que el Ojo sin Pï¿½rpado de Sauron no ve, lo observan e informan de ello sus incontables siervos.

en.title: The Weight of a Legacy
en.gameText: To play, exert a <symbol>sauron</symbol> Orc.  Plays on Aragorn.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½It is because of Men, the Ring survives.... I was there the day the strength of Men failed.'ï¿½

fr.title: Le Poids d'un Hï¿½ritage
fr.gameText: Pour jouer, affaiblissez un Orque <symbol>sauron</symbol>. Jouable sur Aragorn.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½C'est la faute des Hommes si l'Anneau existe encore.... J'ï¿½tais lï¿½ le jour oï¿½ la force des Hommes faillit.'ï¿½

de.title: Die Last des Vermï¿½chtnisses
de.gameText: Strenge einen <symbol>sauron</symbol> Ork an, um diese Karte auf Aragorn zu spielen.
de.loreText: Sie sind dafï¿½r verantwortlich, dass der Ring die Zeit ï¿½berdauert...Ich war dort, als die Stï¿½rke der Menschen versagte.ï¿½

it.title: Il Peso Di Un'Ereditï¿½
it.gameText: Per giocarla, sforza un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol>. Giocala su Aragorn.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½E' a causa degli Uomini che l'Anello sopravvive .... Io c'ero il giorno in cui la forza degli Uomini fallï¿½.'ï¿½

es.title: El Peso de un Legado
es.gameText: Para jugarla, esfuerza un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol>. Se juega en Aragorn.
es.loreText: ï¿½Es por los Hombres, que el Anillo sobrevive... Yo estaba allï¿½ el dï¿½a que la fuerza de los Hombres fallo.ï¿½

en.title: You Bring Great Evil
en.gameText:
To play, spot a <symbol>sauron</symbol> Orc.  Plays on a companion (except an Elf).  
While at a sanctuary, bearer cannot heal.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½And what is this? We have not had dealings with the Dwarves since the Dark Days.'ï¿½

fr.title: Vous Apportez le Grand Mal
fr.gameText: Pour jouer, dï¿½signez un Orque <symbol>sauron</symbol>. Jouable sur un compagnon (exceptï¿½ un Elfe). Tant quï¿½il est ï¿½ un sanctuaire, le dï¿½tenteur ne peut pas guï¿½rir.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Et qu'est-ce ? Nous n'avons pas eu de rapports avec les Nains depuis les Jours Sombres.'ï¿½

de.title: Du trï¿½gst groï¿½es ï¿½bel in dir
de.gameText: Entdecke einen <symbol>sauron</symbol> Ork, um diese Karte auf einen Gefï¿½hrten (ausser einen Elben) zu spielen. Der Trï¿½ger kann, solange er sich an einer Zuflucht befindet, nicht geheilt werden.
de.loreText: Das ist nicht gut. Seit den Dunklen Tagen haben wir nichts mehr mit den Zwergen zu tun gehabt.ï¿½

it.title: Tu Porti Una Grande Sventura
it.gameText: Per giocarla, avvista un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol>. Giocala su un compagno (eccetto un Elfo). Finche ï¿½ in un rifugio, il possessore non puï¿½ essere curato.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½E chi ï¿½ questo? Non trattiamo con i Nani sin dai Giorni Oscuri.'ï¿½

es.title: Traes un Gran Mal
es.gameText: Para jugarla, avista un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol>. Se juega en un compaï¿½ero (excepto un Elfo). Mientras estï¿½ en un refugio, el portador no puede curarse.
es.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Que es esto? No tenemos tratos con los Enanos desde los Dï¿½as Oscuros.ï¿½

en.title: Bilbo
en.subtitle: Retired Adventurer
en.gameText: **Fellowship:** Exert Bilbo to shuffle a <symbol>shire</symbol> card from your discard pile into your draw deck.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½...I don't suppose I have the strength or luck left to deal with the Ring. It has grown, and I have not.'ï¿½

fr.title: Bilbon
fr.subtitle: Aventurier Retraitï¿½
fr.gameText: **Compagnie :** Affaiblissez Bilbon pour mï¿½langer une carte <symbol>shire</symbol> de votre pile de dï¿½fausse dans votre pioche.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½...je suppose qu'il ne me reste plus assez de force ou de chance pour m'occuper de l'Anneau. Il a grandi, et moi pas.'ï¿½

de.title: Bilbo
de.subtitle: Abenteurer im Ruhestand
de.gameText: **Gemeinschaft.** Strenge Bilbo an, um eine <symbol>shire</symbol> Karte aus deinem Ablagestapel in dein Spieldeck zu mischen.
de.loreText: Immerhin glaube ich nicht, dass mir genug Kraft oder Glï¿½ck geblieben ist, um mit dem Ring fertigzuwerden. Er ist gewachsen und ich nicht.ï¿½

it.title: Bilbo
it.subtitle: Avventuriero a Riposo
it.gameText: **Compagnia:** Sforza Bilbo per mescolare una carta <symbol>shire</symbol> presa dalla tua pila degli scarti nel tuo mazzo di gioco.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½...Suppongo che non ho piï¿½ forza e fortuna sufficienti per trattare con l'Anello. Esso ï¿½ cresciuto, e io no.'ï¿½

es.title: Bilbo
es.subtitle: Aventurero Retirado
es.gameText: **Comunidad:** Esfuerza a Bilbo para barajar una carta <symbol>shire</symbol> de tu pila de descartes en tu mazo de robar.
es.loreText: ï¿½...no creo que me quede bastante fuerza o suerte como para tratar con el Anillo. Ha crecido, y yo no.ï¿½

en.title: Bilbo's Pipe
en.gameText:
Bearer must be a Hobbit. 
**Fellowship:** Discard a pipeweed possession and spot X pipes to shuffle X tales from your discard pile into your draw deck.
en.loreText: Bilbo has a fine pipe, carved for him by his Dwarven friends.

fr.title: Pipe de Bilbon
fr.gameText: Le dï¿½tenteur doit ï¿½tre un Hobbit. **Compagnie :** Dï¿½faussez une possession Herbe ï¿½ Pipe et dï¿½signez X pipes pour mï¿½langer X rï¿½cits de votre pile de dï¿½fausse dans votre pioche.
fr.loreText: Bilbon a une magnifique pipe, sculptï¿½e pour lui par ses amis Nains.

de.title: Bilbos Pfeife
de.gameText: Muss auf einen Hobbit gespielt werden. **Gemeinschaft.** Lege ein Pfeifenkraut ab und entdecke X Pfeifen, um X Erzï¿½hlungen aus deinem Ablagestapel in dein Spieldeck zu mischen.
de.loreText: Bilbo besitzt eine schï¿½ne Pfeife, die ihm von seinen Zwergenfreunden gefertigt wurde.

it.title: Pipa di Bilbo
it.gameText:
Il possessore deve essere un Hobbit. 
**Compagnia:** Scarta un bene erba pipa e avvista X pipe per mescolare X racconti presi dalla tua pila degli scarti nel tuo mazzo di gioco.
it.loreText: Bilbo ha un'eccellente pipa, intagliata per lui dai suo amici Nani.

es.title: La Pipa de Bilbo
es.gameText:
El portador debe ser un Hobbit. 
**Comunidad:** Descarta una posesiï¿½n hierba para pipa y avista X pipas para barajar X cuentos de tu pila de descartes en tu mazo de robar.
es.loreText: Bilbo tiene una buena pipa, hecha por sus amigos enanos para ï¿½l.

en.title: Bounder
en.gameText: **Skirmish:** Exert this ally to prevent a Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless that Hobbitï¿½s strength is tripled.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Aye, reckon we're in for a quiet night... mind how you go.'ï¿½

fr.title: Frontalier
fr.gameText: **Combat :** Affaiblissez cet alliï¿½ pour empï¿½cher un Hobbit dï¿½ï¿½tre submergï¿½ ï¿½ moins que la force du camp adverse ne soit trois fois supï¿½rieure ï¿½ celle du Hobbit.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Ouais, la nuit s'annonce calme... faites attention ï¿½ vous.'ï¿½

de.title: Nachtwï¿½chter
de.gameText: **Kampf** Strenge diesen Verbï¿½ndeten an, damit ein Hobbit nur noch mit dreifacher Stï¿½rke ï¿½berwï¿½ltigt werden kann.
de.loreText: Aye, ich denke, es wird eine ruhige Nacht...achtet auf den Weg.ï¿½

it.title: Guardafrontiere
it.gameText: **Schermaglia:** Sforza questo alleato per impedire che un Hobbit sia sopraffatto, a meno che la forza degli avversari non sia il triplo della forza di quellï¿½Hobbit.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Si, calcola che siamo qui per una nottata tranquilla ... io sorveglio in che modo vai.'ï¿½

es.title: Oficial
es.gameText: **Escaramuza:** Esfuerza este aliado para prevenir que un Hobbit sea abrumado a no ser que la fuerza de ese Hobbit sea triplicada.
es.loreText: ï¿½Recordad que estamos aquï¿½ para pasar una noche tranquila... Cuidado como os marchï¿½is.ï¿½

en.title: Extraordinary Resilience
en.gameText: **Response:** If the Ring-bearer is about to heal, remove a burden instead.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Don't despair!' said Strider. ï¿½You must trust me now. Your Frodo is made of sterner stuff than I had guessed....'ï¿½

fr.title: Rï¿½sistance Extraordinaire
fr.gameText: **Rï¿½ponse :** Si le Porteur de lï¿½Anneau est sur le point dï¿½ï¿½tre guï¿½ri, retirez plutï¿½t un point-fardeau.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Ne dï¿½sespï¿½rez pas!' dit Grands-Pas. ï¿½Il faut me faire confiance, maintenant. Votre Frodon est fait d'une pï¿½te plus ferme que je ne l'avais cru....'ï¿½

de.title: Aussergewï¿½hnliche Widerstandskraft
de.gameText: **Reaktion:** Wenn der Ringtrï¿½ger geheilt wird, entferne stattdessen eine Lastmarke.
de.loreText: Verzweifle nicht!ï¿½ sagte Streicher. "Du musst mir jetzt vertrauen. Dein Frodo ist aus hï¿½rterem Holz geschnitzt, als ich vermutet hatte...ï¿½

it.title: Resistenza Straordinaria
it.gameText: **Risposta:** Se il Portatore dellï¿½Anello sta per essere curato, rimuovi invece un segnalino fardello.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Non disperare!' disse Granpasso. ï¿½Devi aver fiducia in me, d'ora in poi. Il tuo Frodo ï¿½ fatto di una pasta piï¿½ dura di quanto credessi....'ï¿½

es.title: Resistencia Extraordinaria
es.gameText: **Respuesta:** Si el Portador del Anillo se va a curar, en vez de eso quita una carga.
es.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½No desesperes! ï¿½ dijo Trancos ï¿½. Confï¿½a en mi ahora. Tu Frodo es de una pasta mas firme de lo que yo pensaba...ï¿½

en.title: Farmer Maggot
en.subtitle: Chaser of Rascals
en.gameText: **Fellowship:** Exert Farmer Maggot to heal Merry or Pippin.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Old Maggot is really a stout fellow ï¿½ if you leave his mushrooms alone.'ï¿½

fr.title: Pï¿½re Maggotte

fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½La Moria! La Moria! Longtemps sont restï¿½es vides ses vastes demeures depuis la fuite des enfants de Durin.ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Groï¿½e Arbeiten wurden dort begonnen
de.gameText:
**Erzï¿½hlung.**
Jedesmal, wenn du einen Zwerg ausspielst, darfst du die obersten 2 Karten von deinem Spieldeck ablegen, um ein <symbol>dwarven</symbol> Ereignis aus deinem Ablagestapel auf deine Hand zu nehmen.

it.gameText: **Racconto.** Giocalo nella tua area di supporto. Ogni volta che giochi un Nano, puoi scartare le prime due carte dal tuo mazzo di gioco per aggiungere alla tua mano un Evento <symbol>dwarven</symbol> dalla pila degli scarti.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Moria! Moria!... Da tempo sono vuoti i vasti palazzi e le grandiose ville, abbandonati dai figli di Durin.'ï¿½

es.gameText: **Cuento.** Cada vez que juegues un Enano, puedes descartar las 2 cartas superiores de tu mazo de robar para poner un evento <symbol>dwarven</symbol> de la pila de descartes en tu mano.
es.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Moria! ï¿½Moria! Por largo tiempo han estado sus salones vacï¿½os desde que la gente de Durin huyï¿½.ï¿½

en.title: Hand Axe
en.gameText:
Bearer must be a Dwarf.
This weapon may be borne in addition to 1 other hand weapon.
**Archery:** Discard this weapon to make the fellowship archery total +1.
en.loreText: Their captain rallied two other orcs to attack. In answer, Gimli's side axe brought him down.

fr.loreText: Leur capitaine lanï¿½a deux autres orques ï¿½ l'attaque. En guise de rï¿½ponse, Gimli lui lanï¿½a sa hachette de main.

de.gameText: Muss auf einen Zwerg gespielt werden. Diese Waffe darf zusï¿½tzlich zu einer weiteren Handwaffe benutzt werden. **FernKampf** Lege diese Waffe ab, um den Fernkampfwert der Gemeinschaft um 1 zu erhï¿½hen.
de.loreText: Ihr Anfï¿½hrer trieb zwei weitere Orks zum Angriff. Im Gegenzug wurde er von Gimlis zweiter Axt erschlagen.

it.gameText:
Il possessore deve essere un Nano. Questï¿½arma puï¿½ essere trasportata in aggiunta a unï¿½altra arma da mischia. 
**Arcieri:** Scarta questï¿½arma per aggiungere +1 al totale degli arcieri della Compagnia.
it.loreText: Il loro capitano incitï¿½ altri due Orchi ad attaccare. Per tutta risposta, l'ascia al fianco di Gimli lo abbattï¿½.

es.gameText:
El portador debe ser un Enano. Este arma puede ser llevada ademï¿½s de otro arma de mano. 
**Arquerï¿½a:** Descarta este arma para que el total de arquerï¿½a de la comunidad sea +1.
es.loreText: El capitï¿½n ordenï¿½ atacar a dos orcos mï¿½s. Como respuesta, el hacha de Gimli lo tumbï¿½.

en.title: Make Light of Burdens
en.gameText:
Plays to your support area.
**Maneuver:** Exert a Dwarf companion and discard the top 3 cards from your draw deck to discard either a Shadow condition from a Dwarf or a weather condition.
en.loreText: A Dwarf does not readily notice the weight on his back, or in his heart.

fr.title: Faire Fi des Fardeaux
fr.gameText: **Manï¿½uvre :** Affaiblissez un compagnon Nain et dï¿½faussez les 3 premiï¿½res cartes de votre pioche pour dï¿½fausser une situation de lï¿½Ombre portï¿½e par un Nain ou une situation de **Climat.**
fr.loreText: Un Nain ne remarque pas le poids sur son dos, ni sur son c*ur.

de.title: Die Last erleichtern
de.gameText: Spiele diese Karte in deinen Unterstï¿½tzungs-bereich. **Manï¿½ver:** Strenge einen Zwergen-gefï¿½hrten an und lege die 3 obersten Karten von deinem Spieldeck ab, um entweder einen Schatteneffekt von einem Zwerg oder einen Wettereffekt im Spiel abzulegen.

it.gameText: **Manovra:** Sforza un compagno Nano e scarta le prime 3 carte dal tuo mazzo di gioco per scartare o una condizione Ombra da un Nano o una condizione atmosferica.
