es.gameText: **Maniobra:** Esfuerza un compaï¿½ero Enano y descarta las 3 cartas superiores de tu mazo de robar para descartar una condiciï¿½n de sombra de un Enano o una condiciï¿½n de **Clima.**
es.loreText: Un Enano no se da verdaderamente cuenta del peso en su espalda, ni en su corazï¿½n.

en.title: Realm of Dwarrowdelf
en.gameText: **Skirmish:** Discard the top 3 cards from your draw deck to make a Dwarf strength +1 (limit +3) and, if underground, **damage +1** (limit +3).
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½There must have been a mighty crowd of dwarves here... and every one of them busier than badgers....'ï¿½

fr.title: Royaume du Cavenain
fr.gameText: **Combat :** Dï¿½faussez les 3 premiï¿½res cartes de votre pioche pour donner +1 en force ï¿½ un Nain (limite de +3) et, si ï¿½ un site souterrain, **dï¿½gï¿½ts +1** (limite de +3).
fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½Il devait y avoir une grande foule de Nains ici ï¿½ une certaine ï¿½poque... et tous plus actifs que des blaireaux...ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Das Reich Zwergenbinge
de.gameText: Spiele diese Karte in deinen Unterstï¿½tzungs-bereich. **Kampf** Lege die obersten 3 Karten von deinem Spieldeck ab, um einem Zwerg Stï¿½rke +1 zu geben (maximal +3) und an einem unterirdischen Ort **Schaden +1** (maximal +3).
de.loreText: Da muï¿½ aber einstmals eine gewaltige Schar von Zwergen hier gewesen sein... Und jeder von ihnen muï¿½ fï¿½nfhundert Jahre lang eifriger geschafft haben als Dachse.ï¿½

it.gameText: **Schermaglia:** Scarta le prime 3 carte dal tuo mazzo di gioco per aggiungere +1 alla forza di un Nano (al massimo +3) e, se in un sotterraneo, **Danno +1** (al massimo +3).
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Ci dev'essere stata una gran folla di Nani qui, un tempo... ed ognuno piï¿½ laborioso di un tasso...'ï¿½

es.title: Reino de la mina del Enano
es.gameText: **Escaramuza:** Descarta las 3 cartas superiores de tu mazo de robar para dar a un Enano fuerza +1 (lï¿½mite +3) y, si estï¿½ en un sitio subterrï¿½neo, **daï¿½o +1** (lï¿½mite +3).
es.loreText: ï¿½Debï¿½a haber una gran multitud de enanos aquï¿½... y cada uno de ellos mï¿½s atareado que un tejï¿½n...ï¿½

en.title: Tidings of Erebor
en.gameText:
**Regroup:** Spot a Dwarf to draw 3 cards. 
Any Shadow player may remove <symbol>twilight3</symbol> to prevent this.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½...we have so far been fortunate, though we do not escape the shadow of these times.'ï¿½

fr.title: Prï¿½sages d'Erebor
fr.gameText: **Ralliement :** Dï¿½signez un Nain pour piocher 3 cartes. Nï¿½importe quel joueur de lï¿½Ombre peut retirer <symbol>twilight3</symbol> pour empï¿½cher ceci.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½...nous avons jusqu'ici ï¿½tï¿½ fortunï¿½s, quoique nous n'ï¿½chappions pas ï¿½ l'assombrissement de ces temps.ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Neuigkeiten vom Erebor
de.gameText: **Sammeln:** Entdecke einen Zwerg, um 3 Karten zu ziehen. Ein beliebiger Schattenspieler darf den Einfluss um <symbol>twilight3</symbol> verringern, um dies zu verhindern.

it.gameText: **Raccolta:** Avvista un Nano per pescare 3 carte. Un qualunque giocatore Ombra puï¿½ rimuovere <symbol>twilight3</symbol> per prevenirlo.

es.title: Noticias de Erebor
es.gameText: **Reagrupaciï¿½n:** Avista un Enano para robar 3 cartas. Cualquier jugador de sombra puede quitar <symbol>twilight3</symbol> para prevenir esto.
es.loreText: ï¿½...de momento hemos sido afortunados, pero no escapamos a la sombra de estos tiempos.ï¿½

en.title: Till Durin Wakes Again
en.gameText:
**Tale.**  
Each time a Dwarf companion moves from an underground site, you may heal that Dwarf.
en.loreText: ï¿½Gimli was silent. Having sung his song, he would say no more.ï¿½

fr.title: Jusqu'ï¿½ ce que Durin du Sommeil se Rï¿½veille
fr.gameText:
**Rï¿½cit.**
Chaque fois quï¿½un Nain quitte un site souterrain, vous pouvez guï¿½rir ce Nain.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ Gimli demeura silencieux. Ayant chantï¿½ sa chanson, il ne voulait plus rien dire. ï¿½

de.gameText:
**Erzï¿½hlung.**
Jedesmal, wenn sich ein Zwergengefï¿½hrte von einem unterirdischen Ort fortbewegt, darfst du diesen Zwerg heilen.

it.gameText: **Racconto.** Giocalo nella tua area di supporto. Ogni volta che un compagno Nano si muove da un sito sotterraneo, puoi curare quel Nano.

es.gameText: **Cuento.** Cada vez que un compaï¿½ero Enano se mueve desde un sitio subterrï¿½neo, puedes curar ese Enano.
es.loreText: ï¿½Gimli no contestï¿½. Habï¿½a cantado su canciï¿½n, y no querï¿½a decir nada mï¿½s.ï¿½

fr.gameText: **Compagnie :** Affaiblissez un Nain pour faire piocher 2 cartes ï¿½ un adversaire. Ce joueur choisit ensuite entre dï¿½fausser 2 cartes de lï¿½Ombre de sa main ou ignorer sa prochaine phase dï¿½**Ombre.**

en.title: A Blended Race

To play, spot an Elf.

es.gameText: Para jugarla, avista un Elfo. Cada Uruk-hai es fuerza -2 y pierde todos sus bonos de daï¿½o. Descarta esta condiciï¿½n durante la fase de reagrupaciï¿½n.

en.gameText: **Response:** If an Elf archer wins a skirmish, make an opponent choose a minion to discard.  That opponent may remove <symbol>twilight3</symbol> to prevent this.

fr.loreText: ï¿½branlï¿½ par la morsure d'une flï¿½che, le Troll des Cavernes devint enragï¿½ en essayant de frapper l'agile Elfe.

de.gameText: **Reaktion:** Wenn ein Elbenbogenschï¿½tze einen Kampf gewinnt, zwinge einen Gegenspieler, einen Diener auszuwï¿½hlen und abzulegen. Dieser Gegenspieler kann den Einfluss um <symbol>twilight3</symbol> verringern, um dies zu verhindern.

it.gameText: **Risposta:** Se un arciere Elfo vince una schermaglia, fai scegliere a un avversario un servitore da scartare. Quellï¿½avversario puï¿½ rimuovere <symbol>twilight3</symbol> per impedirlo.

en.title: Hosts of the Last Alliance
en.gameText:
**Tale.**  
While you can spot an Elf companion, the minion archery total is -1.  
**Response:** If an Elf is about to take a wound, discard this condition to prevent that wound.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½...many great princes and captains were assembled.'ï¿½

fr.title: Armï¿½es de la Derniï¿½re Alliance
fr.gameText:
**Rï¿½cit.**
Tant que vous pouvez dï¿½signer un compagnon Elfe, le total dï¿½archerie des sï¿½ides est de -1. **Rï¿½ponse :** Si un Elfe est sur le point dï¿½ï¿½tre blessï¿½, dï¿½faussez cette situation pour prï¿½venir la blessure.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½...tant de grands princes et capitaines ï¿½taient assemblï¿½s.ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Die Heere des letzten Bï¿½ndnisses
de.gameText: **Erzï¿½hlung.**Solange du einen Elbengefï¿½hrten entdecken kannst, reduziert sich der Fernkampfwert der Diener um 1. **Reaktion:** Wenn einem Elben eine Wunde zugefï¿½gt wird, kannst du diesen Effekt ablegen, um die Wunde ze verhindern.
de.loreText: ...viele groï¿½e Fï¿½rsten und Hauptleute waren versammelt.ï¿½

it.title: Le Armate dell'Ultima Alleanza
it.gameText:
**Racconto.** Giocalo nella tua Area di Supporto. Mentre avvisti un compagno Elfo, sottrai -1 dal totale degli arcieri tra i servitori.

it.loreText: ï¿½...tanti grandi principi e capitani si erano riuniti.ï¿½

es.title: Huestes de la ï¿½ltima alianza
es.gameText:
**Cuento.** Mientras puedas avistar un compaï¿½ero Elfo, el total de arquerï¿½a de los siervos es -1. 
**Respuesta:** Si un Elfo va a recibir una herida, descarta esta condiciï¿½n para prevenir esa herida.
es.loreText: ï¿½...muchos grandes prï¿½ncipes y capitanes estaban reunidos.ï¿½

en.title: Release the Angry Flood
en.gameText: **Maneuver:** Exert an Elf to wound each Nazgï¿½l once (or twice if at a river).
en.loreText: ï¿½The three Riders that were still in the midst of the Ford were overwhelmed.... Their piercing cries were drowned in the roaring of the river as it carried them away.ï¿½

fr.loreText: ï¿½ Les trois cavaliers immobiles au milieu de du Guï¿½ furent submergï¿½s; ils disparurent soudain sous l'ï¿½cume en courroux. ï¿½

de.gameText: **Manï¿½ver:** Strenge einen Elben an, um jeden Nazgï¿½l einmal zu verwunden (oder zweimal, wenn er sich an einem Fluss befindet).
de.loreText: Die drei Reiter, die noch mitten in der Furt waren, wurden umgerissen... Ihre gellenden Schreie gingen unter im Tosen des Flusses, als er sie mitriï¿½.

it.gameText: **Manovra:** Sforza un Elfo per ferire ogni Nazgï¿½l una volta (o due volte se siete a un fiume).
it.loreText: ï¿½I tre Cavalieri che si trovavano ancora in mezzo al Guado furono travolti... Le grida raccapriccianti furono soffocate dal rombo del fiume che li trasportava via.ï¿½

es.gameText: **Maniobra:** Esfuerza un Elfo para herir a cada Nazgï¿½l una vez (o dos veces si estï¿½s en un rï¿½o).

en.title: Secret Sentinels
en.gameText: **Maneuver:** Exert an Elf ally to discard a condition (or 2 conditions if you spot an Orc).
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Yet so little faith and trust do we find now in the world beyond Lothlï¿½rien... that we dare not by our own trust endanger our land.'ï¿½

fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½Toutefois, nous trouvons aujourd'hui si peu de loyautï¿½ et de confiance dans le monde au-delï¿½ de Lothlï¿½rien ... que nous n'osons oas aor notre propre confiance mettre en danger notre terre.ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Geheime Schildwachen
de.gameText: **Manï¿½ver:** Strenge einen Elbenverbï¿½ndeten an, um einen Effekt abzulegen (oder 2 Effekte, wenn du einen Ork entdeckst).
de.loreText: So wenig finden wir noch Treu und Glauben in der Welt auï¿½erhalb von Lothlï¿½rien... ,dass wir es nicht wagen, durch unsere Vertrauensseligkeit unser Land zu gefï¿½hrden.ï¿½

it.title: Sentinelle Segrete
it.gameText: **Manovra:** Sforza un alleato Elfo per scartare una condizione (o 2 condizioni se avvisti un Orco).
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Eppure cosï¿½ poca fede troviamo nel mondo oltre i confini di Lothlï¿½rien... che non osiamo con la nostra fiducia mettere in pericolo il nostro proprio paese.'ï¿½

es.title: Centinelas secretos
es.gameText: **Maniobra:** Esfuerza un aliado Elfo para descartar una condiciï¿½n (o 2 condiciones si avistas un Orco).
es.loreText: ï¿½Tan poca fe y confianza encontramos ahora en el mundo mas allï¿½ de Lothlï¿½rien... que no nos atrevemos a poner en peligro nuestra propia tierra por culpa de nuestra confianza.ï¿½

en.title: Erland
en.subtitle: Advisor to Brand
en.gameText:
To play, spot Gandalf.  
Shadow players may not look at or reveal cards in your hand.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½They are good folk the Bardings. The grandson of Bard the Bowman rules them, Brand son of Bain son of Bard.'ï¿½

fr.title: Erland
fr.subtitle: Conseiller de Brand

fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½Ce sont de bonnes gens les Bardides. Ils sont gouvernï¿½s par les petits-fils de Bard l'Archer: Brand, fils de Baï¿½n fils de Bard.ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Erland
de.subtitle: Berater von Brand

fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½Il passe dans le monde des Ombres. Il sera bientï¿½t un spectre comme eux.ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Welt der Ringgeister
de.gameText: **Kampf** Entdecke einen Zwielicht Nazgï¿½l und den Ringtrï¿½ger, der den Einen Ring benutzt, um 3 Lastmarken auf den Ringtrï¿½ger zu legen.
de.loreText: Er gleitet hinï¿½ber in die Schattenwelt, bald wird er ein Geist sein, genau wie sie.ï¿½

it.title: Mondo degli Spettri

it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Sta entrando nel mondo delle ombre, e presto diventerï¿½ uno spettro come loro.'ï¿½

es.title: Mundo espectral
es.gameText: **Escaramuza:** Avista un Nazgï¿½l de penumbra y al Portador del Anillo llevando puesto El Anillo ï¿½nico para aï¿½adir 3 cargas.
es.loreText: ï¿½Estï¿½ entrando en el mundo de las sombras, pronto se convertirï¿½ en un espectro como ellos.ï¿½

en.title: The Eye of Sauron
en.gameText: **Shadow:** Exert a <symbol>sauron</symbol> Orc and spot X burdens to draw X cards (limit 5).
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½...he has indeed arisen again and left his hold in Mirkwood and returned to his ancient fastness in the Dark Tower of Mordor.'ï¿½

fr.title: L'*il de Sauron
fr.gameText: Ombre : Affaiblissez un Orque <symbol>sauron</symbol> et dï¿½signez X points-fardeau pour piocher X cartes (limite de 5).
fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½... il s'est en effet levï¿½ de nouveau; il a quittï¿½ son repaire de la Forï¿½t Noire pour retourner ï¿½ son ancienne place forte de la Tour Sombre de Mordorï¿½. ï¿½

de.title: Das Auge Saurons
de.gameText: **Schatten:** Strenge einen <symbol>sauron</symbol> Ork an und entdecke X Lastmarken, um X Karten zu ziehen (maximal 5).
de.loreText: ...er hat sich wirklich erhoben und sein Versteck im Dï¿½sterwald verlassen und ist zurï¿½ckgekehrt zu seiner alten Festung im Dunklen Turm von Mordor.ï¿½

it.title: L'Occhio di Sauron
it.gameText: **Ombra:** Sforza un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol> e avvista X segnalini fardello per pescare X carte (al massimo 5).
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½...egli s'ï¿½ messo di nuovo in movimento, abbandonando il suo forte nel Bosco Atro per ritornare ad abitare la vecchia fortezza nella Torre Oscura.'ï¿½

es.title: El ojo de sauron
es.gameText: **Sombra:** Esfuerza un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol> y avista X cargas para robar X cartas (lï¿½mite 5).
es.loreText: ï¿½...se ha alzado de nuevo y ha dejado su fortaleza del Bosque Negro y ha regresado a su vieja reclusiï¿½n en la Torre Oscura de Mordor.ï¿½

en.title: Memory of Many Things
en.gameText: **Maneuver:** Exert a <symbol>sauron</symbol> Orc to discard an ally (or 2 <symbol>elven</symbol> allies).
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½But my memory reaches back even to the Elder Days.... I have seen three ages in the West of the world, and many defeats, and many fruitless victories.'ï¿½

fr.title: Souvenir de Multiples Choses
fr.gameText: **Manï¿½uvre :** Affaiblissez un Orque <symbol>sauron</symbol> pour dï¿½fausser un alliï¿½ (ou 2 alliï¿½s <symbol>ï¿½</symbol>).
fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½Mais ma mï¿½moire porte jusqu'aux Jours Anciens. J'ai vu trois ï¿½ges dans l'Ouest du monde, et maintes dï¿½faites, et maintes victoires sans lendemain.ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Mannigfaltige Erinnerungen
de.gameText: **Manï¿½ver:** Strenge einen <symbol>sauron</symbol> Ork an, um einen Verbï¿½ndeten (oder 2 <symbol>elven</symbol> Verbï¿½ndete) abzulegen.
de.loreText: Aber meine Erinnerung reicht zurï¿½ck bis zur Altvorderenzeit. Ich habe drei Zeitalter im Westen erlebt, und viele Niederlagen und fruchtlose Siege.ï¿½

it.title: Ricordo di Molte Cose
it.gameText: **Manovra:** Sforza un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol> per scartare un alleato (o 2 alleati <symbol>elven</symbol>).
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Ma la mia memoria risale fino ai Tempi Remoti... Ho visto tre ere a ovest del mondo, molte sconfitte e molte vittorie inutili.'ï¿½

es.title: Recuerdo de muchas cosas
es.gameText: **Maniobra:** Esfuerza un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol> para descartar un aliado (o 2 aliados <symbol>elven</symbol>).
es.loreText: ï¿½Pero mi memoria llega aï¿½n a los Dï¿½as Antiguos... He asistido a tres ï¿½pocas en el mundo del Oeste, y a muchas derrotas, y a muchas estï¿½riles victorias.ï¿½

en.title: Orc Scout
en.gameText:
**Tracker.** The roaming penalty for each <symbol>sauron</symbol> minion you play is -1.  
**Response:** If an event is played that spots or exerts a ranger, exert or discard this minion to cancel that event.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Orc!...Not very near, and yet too near, it seems.'ï¿½

fr.title: Flaireur Orque
fr.gameText:
**Traqueur.**
La pï¿½nalitï¿½ dï¿½errance pour chacun des sï¿½ides <symbol>sauron</symbol> que vous jouez est de -1. **Rï¿½ponse :** Si lï¿½on joue un ï¿½vï¿½nement qui dï¿½signe ou affaiblit un rï¿½deur, affaiblissez ou dï¿½faussez ce sï¿½ide pour annuler lï¿½ï¿½vï¿½nement.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½Des orques!... Pas trï¿½s proche, mais trop prï¿½s tout de mï¿½me, semble-t-il.ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Orkspï¿½her
de.gameText:
**Spurenleser.**
Die Strafkosten fï¿½r wandernde <symbol>sauron</symbol> Diener, die du spielst, werden um 1 reduziert. **Reaktion:** Wenn ein Ereignis gespielt wird, das einen Waldlï¿½ufer entdeckt oder anstrengt, dann strenge diesen Diener an oder lege ihn ab, um das Ereignis zu verhindern.
de.loreText: Orks! ... Nicht sehr nahe und doch zu nah, scheint es.ï¿½

it.title: Guida degli Orchi
it.gameText:
**Inseguitore.**
Sottrai -1 alla penalitï¿½ per il vagare di ogni Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol> che giochi.
**Risposta:** Se un evento giocato richiede di avvistare o sforzare un Ramingo, sforza o scarta questo servitore per cancellare quellï¿½evento.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Orchi!... Non molto vicini, tuttavia non abbastanza lontani per essere innocui, a quanto pare.'ï¿½

es.title: Explorador Orco
es.gameText:
**Rastreador.** La penalizaciï¿½n por vagar de cada siervo <symbol>sauron</symbol> que tu juegues es -1. 
**Respuesta:** Si se juega un evento que avista o esfuerza un montaraz, esfuerza o descarta este siervo para cancelar ese evento.
es.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Orcos! ...No muy cerca, pero aun demasiado cerca, parece ser.ï¿½

en.title: Orc Taskmaster
en.gameText: **Shadow:** Exert this minion to add <symbol>twilight1</symbol>.
en.loreText: An Orc acts when the taskmaster promises reward or the whip.

fr.title: Contrï¿½leur Orque
fr.gameText: Ombre : Affaiblissez ce sï¿½ide pour ajouter <symbol>twilight1</symbol>.
fr.loreText: Un orque n'agit que lorsque le contrï¿½leur promet une rï¿½compense ï¿½ ou le fouet.

de.title: Ork Sklaventreiber
de.gameText: **Schatten:** Strenge diesen Diener an, um den Einfluss um <symbol>twilight1</symbol> zu erhï¿½hen.
de.loreText: Ein Ork handelt, wenn der Sklaventreiber Strafe oder Belohnung verspricht.

it.title: Sorvegliante Orco
it.gameText: **Ombra:** Sforza questo servitore per aggiungere <symbol>twilight1</symbol>.
it.loreText: Un Orco si muove quando il sorvegliante promette una ricompensa o la frusta.

es.title: Capataz Orco
es.gameText: **Sombra:** Esfuerza este siervo para aï¿½adir <symbol>twilight1</symbol>.
es.loreText: Un Orco actï¿½a cuando el capataz promete o una recompensa o el lï¿½tigo.

en.title: Southern Spies
en.gameText: **Response:** If the Ring-bearer puts on The One Ring, spot a <symbol>sauron</symbol> minion to make the Free Peoples player discard his or her hand.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½They will know all the news now, for they have visited Bill Ferny; and probably that Southerner was a spy as well.'ï¿½

fr.title: Espions Mï¿½ridionaux
fr.gameText: **Rï¿½ponse :** Si le Porteur de lï¿½Anneau met lï¿½Anneau Unique au doigt, dï¿½signez un sï¿½ide <symbol>sauron</symbol> pour faire dï¿½fausser la main du joueur des Peuples Libres.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½Ils doivent tout connaï¿½tre ï¿½ prï¿½sent, car ils sont allï¿½s chez Bill Fougeron; et sans doute ce type du Sud ï¿½tait-il un espion, lui aussi.ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Spione aus dem Sï¿½den
de.gameText: **Reaktion:** Entdecke einen <symbol>sauron</symbol> Diener, wenn der Ringtrï¿½ger den Einen Ring benutzt, um den Freie Vï¿½lker Spieler zu zwingen, seine Handkarten abzulegen.
de.loreText: Sie werden jetzt ï¿½ber alles Bescheid wissen, denn sie haben Lutz Farning besucht; und wahrscheinlich war auch der Sï¿½dlï¿½nder ein Spï¿½her.ï¿½

it.title: Spie del Sud
it.gameText: **Risposta:** Se il Portatore dellï¿½Anello indossa lï¿½Unico Anello, avvista un servitore <symbol>sauron</symbol> per far scartare al giocatore dei Popoli Liberi la propria mano.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Sapranno tutto, ormai che si sono incontrati con Billy Felci; e probabilmente quel tipo del Sud era anche lui una spia.'ï¿½

es.title: Espï¿½as Sureï¿½os
es.gameText: **Respuesta:** Si el Portador del Anillo se pone El Anillo ï¿½nico, avista un siervo <symbol>sauron</symbol> para hacer que el jugador de Gentes Libres descarte su mano.
es.loreText: ï¿½Ya sabrï¿½n todas las noticias ahora, porque han visitado a Bill Helechal; y probablemente ese Sureï¿½o era un espï¿½a tambiï¿½n.ï¿½

en.title: Spies of Mordor
en.gameText:
**Search.** To play, spot a <symbol>sauron</symbol> Orc.  
Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may draw a card (or 2 cards if you spot a <symbol>sauron</symbol> tracker).
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Mordor Orcs patrol the Eastern Shore. We must wait for the cover of darkness.'ï¿½

fr.title: Espions du Mordor
fr.gameText:
**Recherche.**
Pour jouer, dï¿½signez un Orque <symbol>sauron</symbol>. Lorsque la compagnie se dï¿½place pendant la phase de ralliement, vous pouvez piocher une carte (ou 2 si vous dï¿½signez un traqueur <symbol>sauron</symbol>).
fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½Des Orques du Mordor patrouillent la rive Est. Nous devons attendre le couvert de la nuit.ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Spione aus Mordor
de.gameText: **Suche.** Entdecke einen <symbol>sauron</symbol> Ork, um diese Karte in deinen Unterstï¿½tzungsbereich zu spielen. Jedesmal, wenn sich die Gemeinschaft in der Sammelphase bewegt, darfst du eine Karte ziehen (oder 2 Karten, wenn du einen <symbol>sauron</symbol> Spurenleser entdeckst).
de.loreText: Orks bewachen das Ostufer. Wir warten auf den Einbruch der Dunkelheit.ï¿½

it.title: Spie di Mordor
it.gameText: **Ricerca.** Per giocarla, avvista un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol>. Ogni volta che la compagnia si sposta durante la fase di raccolta, puoi pescare una carta (o 2 carte se avvisti un inseguitore <symbol>sauron</symbol>).
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Gli Orchi di Mordor pattugliano la Riva orientale. Dobbiamo attendere che cali l'oscuritï¿½.'ï¿½

es.title: Espï¿½as de mordor
es.gameText: **Bï¿½squeda.** Para jugarla, avista un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol>. Cada vez que la comunidad se mueve durante la fase de reagrupaciï¿½n, puedes robar una carta (o 2 cartas si puedes avistar un rastreador <symbol>sauron</symbol>).
es.loreText: ï¿½Orcos de Mordor patrullan la orilla este. Debemos esperar la cobertura de la oscuridad.ï¿½

en.title: Tower Assassin
en.gameText: **Maneuver:** Exert Tower Assassin to wound an ally.
en.loreText: A Ring of Power would not stop the blade of an assassin lying in wait.

fr.title: Assassin de la Tour
fr.gameText: **Manï¿½uvre :** Affaiblissez ce sï¿½ide pour blesser un alliï¿½.
fr.loreText: Mï¿½me un Anneau de Pouvoir ne peut arrï¿½ter la lame d'un assassin en embuscade.

de.title: Attentï¿½ter des Turms
de.gameText: **Manï¿½ver:** Strenge den Attentï¿½ter des Turms an, um einen Verbï¿½ndeten zu verwunden.
de.loreText: Ein Ring der Macht vermag nicht, die Klinge eines Attentï¿½ters aus dem Hinterhalt zu aufzuhalten.

it.gameText: **Manovra:** Sforza Assassino della Torre per ferire un alleato.
it.loreText: Nemmeno un Anello del Potere riuscirebbe a fermare la lama di un assassino in attesa.

es.title: Asesino de la torre
es.gameText: **Maniobra:** Esfuerza el Asesino de la torre para herir a un aliado.
es.loreText: Un Anillo de Poder no detendrï¿½a la hoja de un asesino acechando.

en.title: Verily I Come
en.gameText:
To play, exert a <symbol>sauron</symbol> Orc.  Plays on the Ring-bearer. 
Each time the Free Peoples player draws a card (or takes a card into hand) during the fellowship phase, add a burden.
en.loreText: ï¿½There was an eye in the Dark Tower that did not sleep. He knew that it had become aware of his gaze.ï¿½

fr.title: Vraiment Je Viens
fr.gameText:
Pour jouer, affaiblissez un Orque <symbol>sauron</symbol>. Jouable sur le Porteur de lï¿½Anneau.
Chaque fois que le joueur des Peuples Libres pioche une carte (ou prend une carte en main) pendant la phase de compagnie, ajoutez un point-fardeau.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ Il y avait dans la Tour Tï¿½nï¿½breuse un *il qui ne dormait pas. Il sut que cet *il avait pris conscience de son observation. ï¿½

de.gameText: Strenge einen <symbol>sauron</symbol> Ork an, um diese Karte auf den Ringtrï¿½ger zu spielen. Jedesmal, wenn der Freie Vï¿½lker Spieler wï¿½hrend der Gemeinschaftsphase eine Karte zieht (oder auf die Hand nimmt), lege eine Lastmarke auf den Ringtrï¿½ger.
de.loreText: Da war ein Auge im Dunklen Turm, das nicht ruhte. Er wuï¿½te, dass es seinen Blick bemerkt hatte.

it.gameText:
Per giocarla, sforza un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol>. Giocala sul Portatore dellï¿½Anello.
Ogni volta che il giocatore dei Popoli Liberi pesca una carta (o aggiunge una carta alla sua mano) durante la fase della Compagnia, aggiungi un segnalino fardello.
it.loreText: ï¿½Vi era nella Torre Oscura un occhio che non dormiva, che si era accorto dello sguardo di Frodo.ï¿½

es.title: Vengo de verdad
es.gameText: Para jugarla, esfuerza un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol>. Se juega en el Portador del Anillo. Cada vez que el jugador de Gentes Libres roba una carta (o toma una carta en su mano) durante la fase de comunidad, aï¿½ade una carga.
es.loreText: ï¿½Habï¿½a un ojo en la Torre Oscura que no dormï¿½a. Supo que se habï¿½a dado cuenta de su mirada.ï¿½

en.title: Vile Blade
en.gameText:
Bearer must be a <symbol>sauron</symbol> Orc.  
Bearer is strength +2 while skirmishing a Man or Elf.
en.loreText: The blood of enemies slain that day blackened the edge of the commander's blade.

fr.title: Lame Infï¿½me
fr.gameText: Le dï¿½tenteur doit ï¿½tre un Orque <symbol>sauron</symbol>. Le dï¿½tenteur a +2 en force pendant quï¿½il combat un Homme ou un Elfe.
fr.loreText: Le sang des ennemis occis ce jour-lï¿½ noircissait le tranchant de la lame du commandant.

de.gameText: Muss auf einen <symbol>sauron</symbol> Ork gespielt werden. Der Trï¿½ger erhï¿½lt Stï¿½rke +2, wenn er gegen einen Menschen oder Elben kï¿½mpft.
de.loreText: Das Blut erschlagener Feinde schwï¿½rzte an diesem Tag die Klinge des Anfï¿½hrers.

it.title: Lama Vile
it.gameText: Il possessore deve essere un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol> Aggiungi +2 alla forza del possessore quando schermaglia con un Uomo o un Elfo.
it.loreText: Il sangue dei nemici uccisi quel giorno anneriva il taglio della lama del comandante.

es.gameText: El portador debe ser un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol>. El portador es **Daï¿½o +2** mientras estï¿½ en una escaramuza contra un Hombre o un Elfo.
es.loreText: La sangre de los enemigos exterminados ese dï¿½a ennegrecï¿½a el filo de la hoja del comandante.

en.title: Bilbo
en.subtitle: Well-spoken Gentlehobbit
en.gameText: **Fellowship:** Exert Bilbo and discard a tale to discard a Shadow condition from an opponentï¿½s support area.
en.loreText: ï¿½...as Mr. Baggins was generous with his money, most people were willing to forgive him his oddities and his good fortune.ï¿½

fr.title: Bilbon
fr.subtitle: Gentilhobbit Bien Versï¿½
fr.gameText: **Compagnie :** Affaiblissez Bilbon et dï¿½faussez un rï¿½cit pour dï¿½faussez une situation de lï¿½Ombre dans lï¿½aire de soutien dï¿½un adversaire.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ ...comme M. Sacquet ï¿½tait gï¿½nï¿½reux de son argent, la plupart des gens lui pardonnaient volontiers ses singularitï¿½s et sa bonne fortune. ï¿½

de.title: Bilbo
de.subtitle: Feiner Edelhobbit
de.gameText: **Gemeinschaft.** Strenge Bilbo an und lege eine Erzï¿½hlung ab, um einen Schatteneffekt aus dem Unterstï¿½tzungsbereich eines Gegenspielers abzulegen.
de.loreText: ...und da Herr Beutlin nicht kleinlich war mit seinem Geld, waren die meisten Leute gewillt, ihm seine Seltsamkeiten und sein Glï¿½ck zu verzeihen.

it.title: Bilbo
it.subtitle: Gentilhobbit Dammodo
it.gameText: **Compagnia:** Sforza Bilbo e scarta un racconto per scartare una condizione Ombra dallï¿½area di supporto di un avversario.
it.loreText: ï¿½...essendo il signor Baggins generoso, la gente gli perdonava facilmente le sue stranezze e la sua fortuna.ï¿½

es.title: Bilbo
es.subtitle: Respetable gentilhobbit
es.gameText: **Comunidad:** Esfuerza a Bilbo y descarta un cuento para descartar una condiciï¿½n de sombra del ï¿½rea de apoyo de un oponente.
es.loreText: ï¿½...como el Seï¿½or Bolsï¿½n era generoso con su dinero, la mayorï¿½a de la gente estaba dispuesta a perdonarle sus excentricidades y su buena suerte.ï¿½

en.title: Consorting With Wizards
en.gameText:
**Tale.** Bearer must be Bilbo.  
Bilbo may not take wounds (except during the archery phase). 
**Fellowship** or **Regroup:** Exert Bilbo or discard this condition to remove <symbol>twilight1</symbol>.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½He wasn't always this peculiar! When I were a lad, old Bilbo was a most respectable Hobbit.'ï¿½

fr.title: Frï¿½quentations Magiques
fr.gameText:
**Rï¿½cit.**
Le dï¿½tenteur doit ï¿½tre Bilbon. Bilbon ne peut pas ï¿½tre blessï¿½ (sauf pendant la phase dï¿½archerie). Compagnie ou **Ralliement :** Affaiblissez Bilbon ou dï¿½faussez cette situation pour retirer <symbol>twilight1</symbol>.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½Il n'a pas toujours ï¿½tï¿½ aussi particulier! Lorsque j'ï¿½tais un jeune garï¿½on, le vieux Bilbon ï¿½tait un Hobbit des plus respectables.ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Umgang mit Zauberern
de.gameText:
**Erzï¿½hlung.**
Muss auf Bilbo gespielt werden. Bilbo darf nicht verwundet werden (ausser in der Fernkampfphase). Gemeinschaft oder **Sammeln:** Strenge Bilbo an oder lege diesen Effekt ab, um den Einfluss um <symbol>twilight1</symbol> zu verringern.
de.loreText: Er war nicht immer so sonderbar! Als ich noch ein Junge war, war der alte Bilbo ein hï¿½chst ehrbarer Hobbit.ï¿½

it.title: Frequentare gli Stregoni
it.gameText:
**Racconto.** Il possessore deve essere Bilbo. Bilbo non puï¿½ subire ferite (tranne che durante la fase degli Arcieri). Compagnia o 
**Raccolta:** Sforza Bilbo o scarta questa condizione per rimuovere <symbol>twilight1</symbol>.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Non ï¿½ sempre stato cosï¿½ strano! Quando ero un bambino, il vecchio Bilbo era un Hobbit assai rispettabile.'ï¿½

es.title: Asociarse con magos
es.gameText: **Cuento.** El portador debe ser Bilbo. Bilbo no puede recibir heridas (excepto durante la fase de arquerï¿½a). **Comunidad** o **Reagrupaciï¿½n:** Esfuerza a Bilbo o descarta esta condiciï¿½n para quitar <symbol>twilight1</symbol>.
es.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½No siempre habï¿½a sido asï¿½ de peculiar! Cuando yo era un muchacho, el viejo Bilbo era un Hobbit respetable.ï¿½

en.title: Dear Friends
en.gameText: **Fellowship:** Exert a companion to place a Free Peoples card from your discard pile beneath your draw deck (or 2 Free Peoples cards if that companion has the Frodo signet).
en.loreText: ï¿½He pressed him for news of himself and of the wide world... and they stayed up far into the night.ï¿½

fr.title: Chers Amis
fr.gameText: **Compagnie :** Affaiblissez un compagnon pour rï¿½vï¿½ler une carte des Peuples Libres de votre pile de dï¿½fausse et la placer sous votre pioche (ou 2 cartes des Peuples Libres si ce compagnon possï¿½de le sceau de Frodon).
fr.loreText: ï¿½ Il le pressa de lui donner des nouvelles de lui-mï¿½me et du vaste monde... et ils veillï¿½rent fort avant dans la nuit. ï¿½

de.title: Gute Freunde
de.gameText: **Gemeinschaft.** Strenge einen Gefï¿½hrten an, um eine Freie Vï¿½lker Karte aus deinem Ablagestapel unter dein Spieldeck zu legen (oder 2 Freie Vï¿½lker Karten, wenn dieser Gefï¿½hrte das Frodosiegel hat).
de.loreText: Er bestï¿½rmte ihn mit Fragen, wie es ihm ergangen sei und was es Neues in der weiten Welt gebe... und sie blieben bis weit in die Nacht auf.

it.title: Cari Amici
it.gameText: **Compagnia:** Sforza un compagno per mettere una carta dei Popoli Liberi, presa dalla tua pila degli scarti, sotto il tuo mazzo di gioco (o 2 carte dei Popoli Liberi se quel compagno ha il sigillo di Frodo).
it.loreText: ï¿½Sollecitï¿½ notizie sul suo conto e sul resto del mondo... e rimasero in piedi fino a molto tardi.ï¿½

es.title: Amigos queridos
es.gameText: **Comunidad:** Esfuerza un compaï¿½ero para poner una carta de Gentes Libres de tu pila de descartes bajo tu mazo de robar (o 2 cartas de Gentes Libres si ese compaï¿½ero tiene el sello de Frodo).
es.loreText: ï¿½Le preguntï¿½ por noticias de si mismo y de todo el mundo... y estuvieron despiertos hasta muy entrada la noche.ï¿½

en.title: Deft in Their Movements
en.gameText:
**Stealth.**

**Heimlichkeit.** Strenge 2 Hobbits an, um diese Karte in deinen Unterstï¿½tzungsbereich zu spielen.

en.title: Merry
en.subtitle: Horticulturalist
en.gameText: **Fellowship:** Exert Merry to play Farmer Maggot from your draw deck.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Ow... I think I've broken somehing.'ï¿½

fr.subtitle: Horticulteur

fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½Ow... Je crois que je me suis brisï¿½ quelque chose.ï¿½ ï¿½

**Sigilo.**

**Rï¿½cit.**

en.title: Pippin
en.subtitle: Mr. Took

en.title: Red Book of Westmarch

**Tale.**

**Rï¿½cit.**

**Erzï¿½hlung.**

es.gameText: **Cuento.** Cada vez que juegues un cuento, puedes avistar a Bilbo para robar una carta.

en.title: Sam

**Maneuver:** Exert Sam twice to make him **defender +1** until the regroup phase.

fr.title: Sam
fr.subtitle: Hobbit Presque Poï¿½te
fr.gameText:
**Manï¿½uvre :** Affaiblissez Sam deux fois pour le rendre **dï¿½fenseur +1** jusquï¿½ï¿½ la phase de ralliement.

es.subtitle: Poeta peculiar
es.gameText:

es.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Moria! ï¿½Moria! ï¿½Maravilla del mundo del norte!ï¿½

**Archer.**

**Arciere.**

fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½L'Anneau eï¿½t dï¿½ ï¿½tre jetï¿½ au feu d'Orodruin, tout prï¿½s de l'endroit oï¿½ il fut fabriquï¿½.ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Wirf ihn in das Feuer!
de.gameText: **Manï¿½ver:** Entdecke einen Elben, um jeden Gegenspieler zu zwingen, eine Karte aus seiner Hand abzulegen. Ziehe eine Karte fï¿½r jede auf diese Weise abgelegte Karte.
de.loreText: Er hï¿½tte damals in das Feuer des nahe gelegenen Orodruin geworfen werden sollen, wo er gemacht worden war.ï¿½

it.title: Lancialo nel Fuoco!
it.gameText: **Manovra:** Avvista un Elfo per far scartare a ogni avversario una carta dalla sua mano. Pesca una carta per ogni carta scartata in questo modo.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½L'Anello doveva allora essere gettato nel vicino fuoco dell'Orodruin dove era stato fabbricato.'ï¿½

es.title: ï¿½Lï¿½nzalo Al Fuego!
es.gameText: **Maniobra:** Avista un Elfo para hacer que cada oponente descarte una carta de su mano. Roba una carta por cada carta descartada de esta forma.
es.loreText: ï¿½Deberï¿½a haber sido arrojado al fuego del Orodruin donde fue hecho.ï¿½

en.title: Dï¿½nendal
en.subtitle: Silent Scout
en.gameText:
**Archer.**  
**Regroup:** Exert Dï¿½nendal to remove <symbol>twilight2</symbol>.
en.loreText: ï¿½He was almost certain that he could hear stealthy movements.... Not Elves; for the woodland folk were altogether noiseless in their movements.ï¿½

fr.title: Dï¿½nendal
fr.subtitle: ï¿½claireur Silencieux
fr.gameText:
**Archer.**
**Ralliement :** Affaiblissez Dï¿½nendal pour retirer <symbol>twilight2</symbol>.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½Il ï¿½tait presque sï¿½r de percevoir des mouvements furtifs... Ce n'ï¿½taient pas des Elfes; car ceux de la forï¿½t ï¿½taient absolument silencieux dans leurs mouvements. ï¿½

de.title: Dï¿½nendal
de.subtitle: Lautloser Kundschafter
de.gameText:
**Bogenschï¿½tze.**
**Sammeln:** Strenge Dï¿½nendal an, um den Einfluss um <symbol>twilight2</symbol> zu verringern.
de.loreText: Er war fast sicher, dass er... hï¿½rte, wie sich etwas leise bewegte. Nicht Elben waren das; denn das Waldvolk war vï¿½llig gerï¿½uschlos in seinen Bewegungen.

it.title: Dï¿½nendal
it.subtitle: Guida Silenziosa
it.gameText:
**Arciere.**
**Raccolta:** Sforza Dï¿½nendal per rimuovere <symbol>twilight2</symbol>.
it.loreText: ï¿½Era quasi certo di udire movimenti furtivi ai piedi dell'albero. Non erano Elfi; la gente silvestre era assolutamente silenziosa in ogni movimento.ï¿½

es.title: Dï¿½nendal
es.subtitle: Explorador Silencioso
es.gameText: **Arquero.** **Reagrupaciï¿½n:** Esfuerza a Dï¿½nendal para quitar <symbol>twilight2</symbol>.
es.loreText: ï¿½Creï¿½a que podï¿½a oï¿½r movimientos sigilosos... Pero no a los Elfos; ya que la gente de los bosques eran completamente silenciosos en sus movimientos.ï¿½

en.title: Elrond
en.subtitle: Herald to Gil-galad
en.gameText:
At the start of each of your turns, you may spot an ally whose home is site 3 to heal that ally twice.  
**Regroup:** Exert Elrond twice to heal a companion.
en.loreText: ï¿½Venerable he seemed as a king crowned with many winters, and yet hale as a tried warrior....ï¿½

fr.title: Elrond
fr.subtitle: Hï¿½raut de Gil-galad
fr.gameText: Au dï¿½but de chacun de vos tours, vous pouvez dï¿½signer un alliï¿½ dont la demeure est un site 3 pour guï¿½rir cet alliï¿½ deux fois. **Ralliement :** Affaiblissez Elrond deux fois pour guï¿½rir un compagnon.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ Il paraissait aussi vï¿½nï¿½rable qu'un roi couronnï¿½ de maints hivers, et pourtant aussi vigoureux qu'un guerrier ï¿½prouvï¿½... ï¿½

de.title: Elrond
de.subtitle: Gil-galads Herold
de.gameText: Zu Beginn eines jeden deiner Spielzï¿½ge darfst du einen Verbï¿½ndeten mit Heimatort 3 entdecken, um diesen zweimal zu heilen. **Sammeln:** Strenge Elrond zweimal an, um einen Gefï¿½hrten zu heilen.
de.loreText: Verehrungswï¿½rdig erschien er wie ein Kï¿½nig, der viele Winter erlebt hat, und doch rï¿½stig wie ein kampferfahrener Krieger...

it.title: Elrond
it.subtitle: Araldo di Gil-galad
it.gameText:
Allï¿½inizio di ognuno dei tuoi turni, puoi avvistare un alleato la cui casa sia il sito 3 per curare quellï¿½alleato due volte. 
**Raccolta:** Sforza Elrond due volte per curare un compagno.
it.loreText: ï¿½Venerabile come un re coronato da molti inverni, eppur vigoroso come un eroico guerriero nelle pienezza delle sue forze.ï¿½

es.title: Elrond
es.subtitle: Heraldo de Gil-galad
es.gameText:
Al principio de cada uno de tus turnos, puedes avistar un aliado cuyo hogar sea el sitio 3 y curar a ese aliado dos veces. 
**Reagrupaciï¿½n:** Esfuerza a Elrond dos veces para curar un compaï¿½ero.
es.loreText: ï¿½Parecï¿½a venerable como un rey coronado por muchos inviernos, y vigoroso sin embargo como un guerrero probado en la plenitud de sus fuerzas.ï¿½

en.title: Erestor
en.subtitle: Chief Advisor to Elrond
en.gameText:
To play, spot an Elf.  
**Response:** If an Elf is about to take a wound from a <symbol>sauron</symbol> minion or <symbol>sauron</symbol> event, exert Erestor to prevent that wound.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Then there are but two courses... to hide the Ring for ever, or to unmake it.'ï¿½

fr.title: Erestor
fr.subtitle: Conseiller Principal d'Elrond
fr.gameText: Pour jouer, dï¿½signez un Elfe. **Rï¿½ponse :** Si un Elfe est sur le point dï¿½ï¿½tre blessï¿½ par un sï¿½ide <symbol>sauron</symbol> ou un ï¿½vï¿½nement <symbol>sauron</symbol>, affaiblissez Erestor pour prï¿½venir la blessure.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½Dans ce cas, il n'y a que deux solutions... cacher l'Anneau pour toujours; ou le dï¿½truire.ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Erestor
de.subtitle: Oberster Berater Elronds
de.gameText: Entdecke einen Elben, um Erestor zu spielen. **Reaktion:** Strenge Erestor an, wenn ein Elb durch einen <symbol>sauron</symbol> Diener oder ein <symbol>sauron</symbol> Ereignis verwundet wird, um diese Wunde zu verhindern.
de.loreText: Dann gibt es nur zwei Mï¿½glichkeiten... den Ring fï¿½r immer zu verbergen; oder ihn zu zerstï¿½ren.ï¿½

it.title: Erestor
it.subtitle: Capo Consigliere di Elrond
it.gameText:
Per giocarlo, avvista un Elfo.
**Risposta:** Se un Elfo sta per subire una ferita da un servitore <symbol>sauron</symbol> o da un evento <symbol>sauron</symbol>, sforza Erestor per prevenire quella ferita.
it.loreText: ï¿½'Quindi, non vi sono che due direzioni da prendere... nascondere per sempre l'Anello, o distruggerlo.'ï¿½

es.title: Erestor
es.subtitle: Consejero en Jefe de Elrond
es.gameText:
Para jugarlo, avista un Elfo. 
**Respuesta:** Si un Elfo va a recibir una herida de un siervo <symbol>sauron</symbol> o un evento <symbol>sauron</symbol>, esfuerza a Erestor para prevenir esa herida.
es.loreText: ï¿½Entonces sï¿½lo hay dos caminos... esconder el Anillo para siempre, o destruirlo.ï¿½

en.title: Forests of Lothlï¿½rien
en.gameText: Each time the fellowship moves, you may spot 3 <symbol>elven</symbol> allies to wound a minion.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Alas for Lothlï¿½rien that I love! It would be a poor life in a land where no mallorn grew.'ï¿½

fr.title: Les Forï¿½ts de la Lothlï¿½rien
fr.gameText: Chaque fois que la compagnie se dï¿½place, vous pouvez dï¿½signer 3 alliï¿½s <symbol>ï¿½</symbol> pour blesser un sï¿½ide.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½Hï¿½las pour la Lothlï¿½rien que j'aime! Ce serait une pauvre existence dans un pays oï¿½ ne pousserait aucun mallorne.ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Die Bï¿½ume Lothlï¿½riens
de.gameText: Spiele diese Karte in deinen Unterstï¿½tzungs-bereich. Jedes Mal, wenn sich die Gemeinschaft bewegt, darfst du 3 <symbol>elven</symbol> Verbï¿½ndete entdecken, um einen Diener zu verwunden.
de.loreText: Ach, welch ein Jammer um Lothlï¿½rien, das ich liebe! Es wï¿½re ein armseliges Leben in einem Lande, wo kein Mallorn wï¿½chst.ï¿½

it.title: Foreste di Lothlï¿½rien
it.gameText: Ogni volta che la compagnia si muove, puoi avvistare 3 alleati <symbol>elven</symbol> per ferire un servitore.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Ahimï¿½, la mia amata Lothlï¿½rien! Qual vita infelice in una terra ove non crescono i nostri alberi d'oro!'ï¿½

es.title: Bosques de Lothlï¿½rien
es.gameText: Cada vez que la comunidad se mueve, puedes avistar 3 aliados <symbol>elven</symbol> para herir un siervo.
es.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Ay por el Lï¿½rien que yo amo! Serï¿½a un vida triste en una tierra donde no crecieran los mallorn.ï¿½

en.title: Friends of Old
en.gameText: **Fellowship:** Reveal a card at random from an opponentï¿½s hand.  Heal X <symbol>elven</symbol> allies, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½You have been summoned here to answer the threat of Mordor.'ï¿½

fr.title: Amis de Toujours
fr.gameText: **Compagnie :** Rï¿½vï¿½lez une carte au hasard de la main de votre adversaire. Guï¿½rissez X alliï¿½s <symbol>ï¿½</symbol>, oï¿½ X est le coï¿½t crï¿½pusculaire de la carte rï¿½vï¿½lï¿½e.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½Vous avez ï¿½tï¿½ convoquï¿½s ici pour rï¿½pondre ï¿½ la menace de Mordor.ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Freunde aus alten Tagen
de.gameText: **Gemeinschaft.** Decke eine zufï¿½llig bestimmte Karte aus der Hand eines Gegenspielers auf. Heile X <symbol>elven</symbol> Verbï¿½ndete, wobei X den Zwielichtkosten der aufgedeckten Karte entspricht.
de.loreText: Ihr seid hierher gerufen worden, um euch der Bedrohung aus Mordor zu stellen.ï¿½

it.title: Amici di Antica Data
it.gameText: **Compagnia:** Mostra una carta a caso dalla mano dellï¿½avversario. Cura X alleati <symbol>elven</symbol>, dove X ï¿½ il costo crepuscolo della carta mostrata.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Siete stati convocati qui per rispondere alla minaccia di Mordor.'ï¿½

es.title: Amigos de Antaï¿½o
es.gameText: **Comunidad:** Revela una carta al azar de la mano de un oponente. Cura X aliados <symbol>elven</symbol>, donde X es el coste de penumbra de la carta revelada.
es.loreText: ï¿½Habï¿½is sido llamados para responder a la amenaza de Mordor.ï¿½

en.title: Galadriel
en.subtitle: Lady of the Golden Wood
en.gameText:
At the start of each of your turns, you may heal an Elf.  
**Fellowship:** Exert Galadriel to play the fellowship's next site if it is a forest (replacing opponentï¿½s site if necessary).
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½There is in her and in this land no evil, unless a man bring it hither himself. Then let him beware!'ï¿½

fr.title: Galadriel
fr.subtitle: Dame du Bois d'Or
fr.gameText: Au dï¿½but de chaque tour, vous pouvez guï¿½rir un Elfe. **Compagnie :** Affaiblissez Galadriel pour jouer le prochain site de la compagnie si cï¿½est une forï¿½t (remplacant le site de lï¿½adversaire si nï¿½cessaire).
fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½Il n'y a en elle ni dans ce pays nul mal, autre que celui qu'y apporterait un homme lui-mï¿½me. Et alors, qu'il prenne garde!ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Galadriel
de.subtitle: Herrin des Goldenen Waldes
de.gameText: Zu Beginn eines jeden deiner Spielzï¿½ge darfst du einen Elben heilen. **Gemeinschaft.** Strenge Galadriel an, um die nï¿½chste Ortskarte deiner Gemeinschaft zu spielen, wenn es ein Wald ist (und nï¿½tigenfalls die Ortskarte eines Gegenspielers zu ersetzen).
de.loreText: ... doch nur Bï¿½se mï¿½ssen das Land fï¿½rchten, oder jene, die irgend etwas Bï¿½ses mit sich bringen.ï¿½

it.title: Galadriel
it.subtitle: Dama del Bosco d'Oro
it.gameText:
Allï¿½inizio di ognuno dei tuoi turni, puoi curare un Elfo. 
**Compagnia:** Sforza Galadriel per giocare il prossimo sito della compagnia se ï¿½ una foresta (rimpiazzando il sito dellï¿½avversario se necessario).
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Non vi ï¿½ in lei e in questa terra alcun male, salvo che un uomo non ve lo porti lui stesso. E allora guai a lui!'ï¿½

es.title: Galadriel
es.subtitle: Dama del Bosque Dorado
es.gameText:
Al principio de cada uno de tus turnos, puedes curar un Elfo. 
**Comunidad:** Esfuerza a Galadriel para jugar el sitio siguiente de la comunidad si es un bosque (reemplazando el del oponente si es necesario).
es.loreText: ï¿½En ella y en esta tierra no hay ningï¿½n mal, a no ser que un hombre lo traiga aquï¿½ ï¿½l mismo. Y entonces ï¿½que ï¿½l se cuide!ï¿½

en.title: Galdor
en.subtitle: Councilor From the West
en.gameText:
To play, spot an Elf.  
**Regroup:** Exert Galdor and spot a minion to return that minion to its ownerï¿½s hand.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½My heart tells me that Sauron will expect us to take the western way, when he learns what has befallen. He soon will.'ï¿½

fr.title: Galdor
fr.subtitle: Conseiller de l'Ouest
fr.gameText: Pour jouer, dï¿½signez un Elfe. **Ralliement :** Affaiblissez Galdor et dï¿½signez un sï¿½ide pour renvoyer ce sï¿½ide ï¿½ la main de son propriï¿½taire.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½Mon coeur me dit qu'en apprenant ce qui est arrivï¿½, Sauron s'attendra que nous prenions la route de l'Ouest. Et il ne tardera pas ï¿½ le savoir.ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Galdor
de.subtitle: Ratsmitglied aus dem Westen
de.gameText: Entdecke einen Elben, um Galdor zu spielen. **Sammeln:** Strenge Galdor an und entdecke einen Diener, um diesen Diener auf die Hand seines Besitzers zurï¿½ck zu schicken.
de.loreText: Mein Herz sagt mir, dass, sobald Sauron erfï¿½hrt, was geschehen ist, und das wird er bald erfahren, er annehmen wird, dass wir den Weg nach Westen einschlagen.ï¿½

it.title: Galdor
it.subtitle: Consigliere dall'Ovest
it.gameText:
Per giocarlo, avvista un Elfo. 
**Raccolta:** Sforza Galdor e avvista un servitore per rimandare quel servitore in mano al suo possessore.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Il cuore mi dice che Sauron prevederï¿½ una nostra eventuale corsa ad occidente, quando sarï¿½ al corrente dell'accaduto; e presto lo sarï¿½.'ï¿½

es.title: Galdor
es.subtitle: Concejal del Oeste
es.gameText:
Para jugarlo, avista un Elfo. 
**Reagrupaciï¿½n:** Esfuerza a Galdor y avista un siervo para devolver ese siervo a la mano de su propietario.
es.loreText: ï¿½El poder que aï¿½n nos queda estï¿½ aquï¿½ en Imladris, o con Cï¿½rdan en los Puertos, o en Lï¿½rien.ï¿½

en.title: Gift of the Evenstar
en.gameText:
To play, spot Arwen.  Bearer must be Aragorn.  
**Skirmish:** Exert Aragorn or discard 2 cards from hand to make a minion skirmishing Aragorn strength -1.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½It is mine to give to whom I will... like my heart.'ï¿½

fr.title: Don de l'ï¿½toile du Soir

fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½Il me revient de le donner ï¿½ qui je le dï¿½sire... tout comme mon coeur.ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Gabe des Abendsterns
de.gameText: Entdecke Arwen, um diesen Effekt zu spielen. Muss auf Aragorn gespielt werden. **Kampf** Strenge Aragorn an oder lege 2 Karten aus deiner Hand ab, um einem Diener, der gegen Aragorn kï¿½mpft, Stï¿½rke -1 zu geben.
de.loreText: Es gehï¿½rt mir und ich schenke es, wem ich will... wie mein Herz.ï¿½

it.title: Dono della Stella del Vespro
it.gameText:
Per giocarla, avvista Arwen. Il possessore deve essere Aragorn. 
**Schermaglia:** Sforza Aragorn o scarta 2 carte dalla mano per sottrarre -1 alla forza di un servitore che stia schermagliando con Aragorn.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Sta a me donarla a colui che desidero... Come il mio cuore.'ï¿½

es.title: Don de la Estrella de la Tarde
es.gameText: Para jugarla, avista a Arwen. El portador debe ser Aragorn. **Escaramuza:** Esfuerza a Aragorn o descarta 2 cartas de la mano para dar a un siervo que este en una escaramuza contra Aragorn fuerza -1.
es.loreText: ï¿½Es mï¿½o para dï¿½rselo a quien yo quiera... Como mi corazï¿½n.ï¿½

en.title: Golradir
en.subtitle: Councilor of Imladris
en.gameText:
To play, spot an Elf.  
**Skirmish:** Exert Golradir to make an Orc strength -1.
en.loreText: Their stay at Rivendell provided the Fellowship with counsel from many sources.

fr.title: Golradir
fr.subtitle: Conseiller d'Imladris
fr.gameText: Pour jouer, dï¿½signez un Elfe. **Combat :** Affaiblissez Golradir pour donner -1 en force ï¿½ un Orque.
fr.loreText: Le sï¿½jour ï¿½ Fondcombe leur offra plus que du repos; des conseillers de toutes parts apportï¿½rent leur savoir.

de.title: Golradir
de.subtitle: Ratsherr von Imladris
de.gameText: Entdecke einen Elben, um Golradir zu spielen. **Kampf:** Strenge Golradir an, um einem Ork Stï¿½rke -1 zu geben.
de.loreText: Ihr Aufenthalt in Bruchtal brachte der Gemeinschaft gute Ratschlï¿½ge von allen Seiten ein.

it.title: Golradir
it.subtitle: Consigliere di Imladris
it.gameText:
Per giocarlo, avvista un Elfo. 
**Schermaglia:** Sforza Golradir per sottrarre -1 alla forza di un Orco.
it.loreText: La sosta a Gran Burrone procurï¿½ alla Compagnia consigli da molte parti.

es.title: Golradir
es.subtitle: Concejal de Imladris
es.gameText: Para jugarlo, avista un Elfo. **Escaramuza:** Esfuerza a Golradir para darle a un Orco fuerza -1.
es.loreText: Su estancia en Rivendel proporcionï¿½ a la comunidad consejo de diversas fuentes.

en.title: Long-knives of Legolas
en.gameText:
Bearer must be Legolas. 
Each Orc or Uruk-hai skirmishing Legolas is strength -2.
en.loreText: Sharp, bone-handled knives defend the Elves of Mirkwood at close quarters.

fr.title: Les Longs Couteaux de Legolas
fr.gameText: Le dï¿½tenteur doit ï¿½tre Legolas. Chaque Orque ou Ourouk-Haï¿½ combattant Legolas a -2 en force.
fr.loreText: Au corps ï¿½ corps, les Elfes de la Forï¿½t Noire se servent de leur longs couteaux affutï¿½es pour se dï¿½fendre.

de.title: Legolas' Langmesser
de.gameText: Muss auf Legolas gespielt werden. Alle Orks oder Uruk-hai, die gegen Legolas kï¿½mpfen, erhalten Stï¿½rke -2.
de.loreText: Scharfe Messer, mit Knochengriffen versehen, schï¿½tzen die Elben aus dem Dï¿½sterwald im Nahkampf.

it.title: I Lunghi Pugnali di Legolas
it.gameText: Il possessore deve essere Legolas. Sottrai -2 alla forza di ogni Orco o Uruk-hai che schermagli con Legolas.
it.loreText: Gli affilati pugnali dal manico d'osso proteggono gli Elfi di Bosco Atro negli scontri ravvicinati.

es.title: Cuchillos Largos de Legolas
es.gameText: El portador debe ser Legolas. Cada Orco o Uruk-hai en una escaramuza contra Legolas es fuerza -2.
es.loreText: Cuchillos afilados, con empuï¿½aduras de hueso defienden a los Elfos del Bosque Negro en el cuerpo a cuerpo.

en.title: Master of Healing
en.gameText: **Fellowship:** or **Regroup:** Spot Elrond (or 2 <symbol>elven</symbol> allies) to heal a companion or ally.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Elrond has cured you: he has tended you for days, ever since you were brought in.'ï¿½

fr.title: Maï¿½tre Guï¿½risseur
fr.gameText: Compagnie ou **Ralliement :** Dï¿½signez Elrond (ou 2 alliï¿½s <symbol>ï¿½</symbol>) pour guï¿½rir un compagnon ou un alliï¿½.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½Elrond vous a guï¿½ri: il vous a soignï¿½ plusieurs jours durant, depuis le moment oï¿½ on vous a apportï¿½ ici.ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Meister der Heilkï¿½nste
de.gameText: Gemeinschaft oder **Sammeln:** Entdecke Elrond (oder 2 <symbol>elven</symbol> Verbï¿½ndete), um einen Gefï¿½hrten oder Verbï¿½ndeten zu heilen.
de.loreText: Elrond hat dich geheilt: tagelang hat er dich gepflegt, seit du hergebracht wurdest.ï¿½

it.title: Maestro della Guarigione
it.gameText:
Compagnia o 
**Raccolta:** Avvista Elrond (o 2 alleati <symbol>elven</symbol>) per curare un compagno o un alleato.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Fu Elrond a curarti, in questi giorni, da quando fosti portato qui.'ï¿½

es.title: Maestro de la Curaciï¿½n
es.gameText: **Comunidad** o **Reagrupaciï¿½n:** Avista a Elrond (o a 2 aliados <symbol>elven</symbol>) para curar un compaï¿½ero o un aliado.
es.loreText: ï¿½Elrond te ha curado: te ha atendido durante dï¿½as, desde el momento en el que te trajeron.ï¿½

en.title: Nenya
en.gameText:
Bearer must be Galadriel. 
At the start of each regroup phase, you may discard up to 2 cards from hand to draw the same number of cards.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Verily it is in the land of Lï¿½rien upon the finger of Galadriel that one of the Three remains. This is Nenya, the Ring of Adamant, and I am its keeper.'ï¿½

fr.title: Nenya
fr.gameText: Le dï¿½tenteur doit ï¿½tre Galadriel. Au dï¿½but de chaque phase de ralliement, vous pouvez dï¿½faussez jusquï¿½ï¿½ 2 cartes de votre main pour piocher le mï¿½me nombre de cartes.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½En vï¿½ritï¿½, c'est dans le pays de Lorien, au doigt de Galadriel, que reste l'un des Trois. Celui qui est Nenya, l'Anneau de Diamant, et j'en suis la gardienne.ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Nenya

**Tale.**

**Erzï¿½hlung.**

en.title: Narya

en.title: Get Off the Road!
en.gameText:
**Search.**  
**Shadow:** Spot a <symbol>sauron</symbol> minion and a Nazgï¿½l to make the Free Peoples player discard a card from the top of his or her deck for each burden you can spot.

**Recherche.**

de.loreText: Ein Ring der Macht passt selbst auf sich auf. Er kann sich heimtï¿½ckisch davonmachen, aber sein Hï¿½ter gibt ihn niemals auf.ï¿½

it.title: Brilla nella Neve
it.gameText: **Raccolta:** Sforza un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol> e avvista un compagno <symbol>gondor</symbol> per aggiungere un segnalino fardello.

es.gameText: **Reagrupaciï¿½n:** Esfuerza un Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol> y avista un compaï¿½ero <symbol>gondor</symbol> para aï¿½adir una carga.

en.title: Hand of Sauron
en.gameText: **Maneuver:** Exert a <symbol>sauron</symbol> minion to make the Free Peoples player discard a card at random from his or her hand.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½The power of the Ring could not be undone.'ï¿½

fr.title: La Main de Sauron

fr.loreText: ï¿½ Le pouvoir de l'Anneau ne pouvait ï¿½tre vaincu. ï¿½

it.gameText: **Manovra:** Sforza un servitore <symbol>sauron</symbol> per far scartare una carta a caso al giocatore dei Popoli Liberi dalla sua mano .
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Il potere dell'Anello non puï¿½ essere annullato.'ï¿½

es.title: Mano de Sauron
es.gameText: **Maniobra:** Esfuerza un siervo <symbol>sauron</symbol> para hacer que el jugador de Gentes Libres descarte una carta al azar de su mano.
es.loreText: ï¿½El Poder del Anillo no podï¿½a ser deshecho.ï¿½

en.title: His Cruelty and Malice

en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Into this Ring he poured his cruelty, his malice, and his will to dominate all life.'ï¿½

fr.title: Sa Cruautï¿½ et sa Malveillance

fr.loreText: ï¿½ Dans cet Anneau il versa sa cruautï¿½, sa malveillance et sa volontï¿½ de dominer toute vie. ï¿½

en.gameText: **Regroup:** Exert a <symbol>sauron</symbol> minion to discard a card from the top of the Free Peoples playerï¿½s draw deck for each of these races you can spot in the fellowship: Dwarf, Elf, Man, and Wizard.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½The power of the Black Land grows....'ï¿½

fr.title: Rassemblement dans l'Est

fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½Le pouvoir de la Terre Noire s'accroï¿½t...ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Aushebungen im Osten

es.title: Concentraciï¿½n en el Este
es.gameText: **Reagrupaciï¿½n:** Esfuerza un siervo <symbol>sauron</symbol> para descartar una carta de la parte superior del mazo de robar del jugador de Gentes Libres por cada una de estas razas que puedas avistar en la comunidad: Enano, Elfo, Hombre y Mago.

en.title: Morgul Slayer
en.gameText: **Regroup:** Exert this minion to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Sauron was diminished, but not destroyed. His Ring was lost but not unmade.'ï¿½

fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½Sauron fut diminuï¿½, mais non dï¿½truit. Son Anneau ï¿½tait perdu, mais non dï¿½fait.ï¿½ ï¿½

en.title: Orc Slayer
en.gameText: **Regroup:** Exert this minion to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
en.loreText: ï¿½For it is a long tale, full of deeds great and terrible....ï¿½

fr.title: Massacreur Orque
fr.gameText: **Ralliement :** Affaiblissez ce sï¿½ide pour blesser un compagnon (exceptï¿½ le Porteur de lï¿½Anneau).
fr.loreText: ï¿½ Car c'est une longue histoire, pleine de grands et terribles faits... ï¿½

it.title: Orco Uccisore

it.loreText: ï¿½E' infatti una storia lunga, irta di grandi e terribili gesta...'ï¿½

es.title: Exterminador Orco
es.gameText: **Reagrupaciï¿½n:** Esfuerza este siervo para herir un compaï¿½ero (excepto el Portador del Anillo).
es.loreText: ï¿½Porque es una larga historia, llena de gestas grandes y terribles...ï¿½

en.title: Orc Trooper

fr.title: Fantassin Orque
fr.gameText: Pour chaque carte dans votre main, ce sï¿½ide a +1 en force.

de.title: Ork Fuï¿½soldat

de.loreText: Die Macht des Dunklen Herrschers wï¿½chst auf viele verborgene Weisen.

es.title: Soldado Orco

es.loreText: El poder del Seï¿½or Oscuro crece en formas ocultas.

en.title: Orc Veteran

it.loreText: ï¿½Allora vi fu la guerra; e il paese fu spianato...'ï¿½

es.loreText: ï¿½Hubo guerra, y la tierra se convirtiï¿½ en desolaciï¿½n...ï¿½

en.loreText: ï¿½Orcs were multiplying again in the mountains.ï¿½

fr.title: Guerrier Orque

fr.loreText: ï¿½ Les orques se multipliaient de nouveau dans les montagnes. ï¿½

de.title: Ork Krieger
de.gameText: **Manï¿½ver:** Strenge diesen Diener an und lege einen deiner <symbol>sauron</symbol> Effekte ab, um den Freie Vï¿½lker Spieler zu zwingen, die beiden obersten Karten von seinem Spieldeck abzulegen.
de.loreText: Die Orks nahmen wieder an Zahl zu in den Bergen.

en.title: Our List of Allies Grows Thin
en.gameText:
To play, exert a <symbol>sauron</symbol> minion.   
Each time the fellowship moves, add <symbol>twilight1</symbol> for each ally you can spot.

it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Il nemico ï¿½ in marcia... il suo occhio ï¿½ fisso su Gran Burrone. E, a quanto mi dici, Saruman ci ha traditi.'ï¿½

es.title: Nuestra Lista de Aliados se Reduce
es.gameText: Para jugarla, esfuerza un siervo <symbol>sauron</symbol>. Cada vez que la comunidad se mueve, aï¿½ade <symbol>twilight1</symbol> por cada aliado que puedas avistar.
es.loreText: ï¿½El enemigo se mueve... Su ojo estï¿½ fijo en Rivendel. Y Saruman, como me dices, nos ha traicionado.ï¿½

en.title: Terrible as the Dawn
en.gameText: **Maneuver:** Spot a <symbol>sauron</symbol> minion to wound Galadriel 3 times.  The Free Peoples player may discard 2 Elves to prevent this.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½In the place of the Dark Lord, you would have a Queen... All shall love me and despair!'ï¿½

fr.title: Terrible Comme le Matin
fr.gameText: **Manï¿½uvre :** Dï¿½signez un sï¿½ide <symbol>sauron</symbol> pour blesser Galadriel trois fois. Le joueur des Peuples Libres peut dï¿½fausser deux Elfes pour empï¿½cher ceci.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½ï¿½ la place du Seigneur Tï¿½nï¿½breux, vous ï¿½tablirez une Reine! Tous m'aimeront et dï¿½sespï¿½reront!ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Entsetzlich wie der Morgen
de.gameText: **Manï¿½ver:** Entdecke einen <symbol>sauron</symbol> Diener, um Galadriel dreimal zu verwunden. Der Freie Vï¿½lker Spieler darf 2 Elben ablegen, um dies zu verhindern.
de.loreText: Anstelle eines dunklen Herrschers hï¿½ttest du eine Kï¿½nigin.... Alle werden mich lieben und verzweifeln!ï¿½

it.title: Terribile come l'Alba
it.gameText: **Manovra:** Avvista un servitore <symbol>sauron</symbol> per ferire 3 volte Galadriel. Il giocatore dei Popoli Liberi puï¿½ scartare 2 Elfi per prevenirlo.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Al posto dell'Oscuro Sire avresti una Regina... Tutti mi ameranno e si dispereranno!ï¿½

es.title: Terrible Como el Amanecer
es.gameText: **Maniobra:** Avista un siervo <symbol>sauron</symbol> para herir a Galadriel 3 veces. El jugador de Gentes Libres puede descartar 2 Elfos para prevenir esto.
es.loreText: ï¿½En lugar del Seï¿½or Oscuro, tendrï¿½ais a una Reina... ï¿½Todos me amaran y desesperaran!ï¿½

en.title: Tower of Barad-dï¿½r
en.gameText:
To play, exert a <symbol>sauron</symbol> minion.  
Each time the fellowship moves, the Free Peoples player must discard a card from hand.
en.loreText: ï¿½The Dark Tower had been rebuilt, it was said. From there the power was spreading....ï¿½

fr.title: La Tour de Barad-dï¿½r
fr.gameText: Pour jouer, affaiblissez un sï¿½ide <symbol>sauron</symbol>. Chaque fois que la compagnie se dï¿½place, le joueur des Peuples Libres doit dï¿½fausser une carte de sa main.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ La Tour Noire avait ï¿½tï¿½ reconstruite, ï¿½ ce qu'on disait. De lï¿½, la puissance s'ï¿½tendait... ï¿½

de.title: Der Turm von Barad-dï¿½r
de.gameText: Strenge einen <symbol>sauron</symbol> Diener an, um diese Karte in deinen Unterstï¿½tzungsbereich zu spielen. Jedes Mal, wenn sich die Gemeinschaft bewegt, muss der Freie Vï¿½lker Spieler eine Karte aus seiner Hand ablegen.
de.loreText: Der Dunkle Turm sei wieder aufgebaut worden, hieï¿½ es. Von dort breitete sich die Macht weitum aus....ï¿½

it.title: Torre di Barad-dï¿½r
it.gameText: Per giocarla, sforza un servitore <symbol>sauron</symbol>. Ogni volta che la compagnia si muove, il giocatore dei Popoli Liberi deve scartare una carta dalla sua mano.
it.loreText: ï¿½La Torre Oscura pareva fosse stata ricostruita: da lï¿½ le forze si diramavano in tutte le direzioni...ï¿½

es.title: Torre de Barad-dï¿½r
es.gameText: Para jugarla, avista un siervo <symbol>sauron</symbol>. Cada vez que la comunidad se mueve, el jugador de Gentes Libres debe descartar una carta de su mano.
es.loreText: ï¿½La Torre Oscura ha sido erguida de nuevo, se dijo. Desde ahï¿½ el poder iba expandiï¿½ndose...ï¿½

en.title: Why Shouldn't I Keep It?
en.gameText: **Maneuver:** Spot a <symbol>sauron</symbol> minion to discard Bilbo.  The Free Peoples player may discard 2 Free Peoples conditions to prevent this.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½No, wait, it's here in my pocket. Isn't that... isn't that odd now?'ï¿½

fr.title: Pourquoi ne le Garderais-Je Pas?
fr.gameText: **Manï¿½uvre :** Dï¿½signez un sï¿½ide <symbol>sauron</symbol> pour dï¿½fausser Bilbon. Le joueur des Peuples Libres peut dï¿½fausser deux situations des Peuples Libres pour empï¿½cher ceci.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½Non, attendez, il est ici dans ma poche. N'est-ce pas... n'est-ce pas ï¿½trange? Et puis aprï¿½s tout, pourquoi pas?ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Warum sollte ich ihn nicht behalten?
de.gameText: **Manï¿½ver:** Entdecke einen <symbol>sauron</symbol> Diener, um Bilbo abzulegen. Der Freie Vï¿½lker Spieler darf 2 Effekte der Freien Vï¿½lker ablegen, um dies zu verhindern.
de.loreText: Nein, warte, er ist hier in meiner Tasche. Ist das nicht, ist das nicht seltsam?ï¿½

it.title: Perchï¿½ non Dovrei Tenerlo?
it.gameText: **Manovra:** Avvista un servitore <symbol>sauron</symbol> per scartare Bilbo. Il giocatore dei Popoli Liberi puï¿½ scartare 2 condizioni dei Popoli Liberi per prevenirlo.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½No, aspetta, sta qui nella mia tasca. Non ï¿½... non ï¿½ strano?'ï¿½

es.title: ï¿½Porquï¿½ No Deberï¿½a Quedï¿½rmelo?
es.gameText: **Maniobra:** Avista un siervo <symbol>sauron</symbol> para descartar a Bilbo. El jugador de Gentes Libres puede descartar 2 condiciones de Gentes Libres para prevenir esto.
es.loreText: ï¿½No, espera, estï¿½ aquï¿½ en mi bolsillo. No es... ï¿½No es raro? Pero, despuï¿½s de todo, ï¿½porquï¿½ no?ï¿½

en.title: Bill the Pony
en.gameText:
Bearer must be a Hobbit companion.  
The Shadow number of each site is -1. 
Discard Bill the Pony when at an underground site.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½That animal can nearly talk.... He gave me a look as plain as Mr. Pippin could speak....'ï¿½

fr.title: Bill le Poney
fr.gameText: Le dï¿½tenteur doit ï¿½tre un compagnon Hobbit. La puissance de lï¿½Ombre ï¿½ chaque site est de -1. Dï¿½faussez Bill le Poney sï¿½il se trouve ï¿½ un site souterrain pendant la phase de compagnie ou de ralliement.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½Cette bï¿½te peut presque parler... Elle m'a dit par le regard aussi clairement que M. Pippin aurait pu l'exprimer en paroles...ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Lutz, das Pony
de.gameText: Muss auf einen Hobbitgefï¿½hrten gespielt werden. Die Schattenzahl jedes Ortes reduziert sich um 1. Lege Lutz, das Pony an einem unterirdischen Ort ab.
de.loreText: Das Tier kann fast sprechen... Es warf mir einen Blick zu, der ebenso deutlich das besagte, was Herr Pippin ausgesprochen hat...ï¿½

it.title: Bill il Pony
it.gameText: Il possessore deve essere un compagno Hobbit. Il numero Ombra di ogni sito diminuisce di -1. Scarta Bill il Pony quando sei in un sito **Sotterraneo.**
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Quell'animale sa quasi parlare... mi ha lanciato uno sguardo esplicito quanto le parole del signor Pipino...'ï¿½

es.title: Bill el Pony
es.gameText: El portador debe ser un compaï¿½ero Hobbit. El nï¿½mero de Sombra de cada sitio es -1. Descarta a Bill el Pony cuando estï¿½ en un sitio **Subterrï¿½neo.**
es.loreText: ï¿½Ese animal casi habla... me echï¿½ una mirada tan elocuente como las palabras del Seï¿½or Pippin...ï¿½

en.title: Frodo's Pipe
en.gameText:
Bearer must be Frodo.  
**Fellowship:** Discard a pipeweed possession and spot X pipes to heal a companion with the Frodo signet X times.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½All the same, observations that I have made on my own many journeys south have convinced me that the weed itself is not native to our parts of the world.'ï¿½

fr.title: La Pipe de Frodon
fr.gameText: Le dï¿½tenteur doit ï¿½tre Frodon. **Compagnie :** Dï¿½faussez une possession Herbe ï¿½ pipe et dï¿½signez X pipes pour guï¿½rir X fois un compagnon possï¿½dant le sceau de Frodon.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½Nï¿½anmoins, certaines observations que j'ai faites au cours de mes nombreux voyages dans le sud m'ont convaincu que l'herbe mï¿½me n'est pas originaire de notre partie du monde...ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Frodos Pfeife
de.gameText: Muss auf Frodo gespielt werden. **Gemeinschaft.** Lege ein Pfeifenkraut ab und entdecke X Pfeifen, um einen Gefï¿½hrten mit dem Frodosiegel X mal zu heilen.
de.loreText: Beobachtungen, die ich selbst auf meinen vielen Reisen nach dem Sï¿½den machen konnte, haben mich indessen ï¿½berzeugt, dass das Kraut nicht zu den einheimischen Pflanzen unseres Teils der Welt gehï¿½rt...ï¿½

it.title: La Pipa di Frodo
it.gameText:
Il possessore deve essere Frodo. 
**Compagnia:** Scarta un bene Erba-pipa e avvista X pipe per curare X volte un compagno con il sigillo di Frodo.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Ciï¿½ nonostante, dalle ricerche compiute da me personalmente durante numerosi viaggi nel Sud, risulta che detta erba non ï¿½ originaria delle nostre parti.'ï¿½

es.title: La Pipa de Frodo
es.gameText:
El portador debe ser Frodo. 
**Comunidad:** Descarta una posesiï¿½n hierba para pipa y avista X pipas para curar un compaï¿½ero con el sello de Frodo X veces.
es.loreText: ï¿½Al mismo tiempo, mis propias observaciones en los viajes que hice al sur me convencieron de que la hierba no es originaria de nuestra regiï¿½n.ï¿½

en.title: Frying Pan
en.gameText:
Bearer must be a Hobbit.  
**Skirmish:** Exert bearer to wound an Orc he or she is skirmishing.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½I think I'm getting the hang of this!'ï¿½

fr.title: Poï¿½le ï¿½ Frire
fr.gameText: Le dï¿½tenteur doit ï¿½tre un Hobbit. **Combat :** Affaiblissez le dï¿½tenteur pour blesser un Orque quï¿½il combat.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½Je crois que je commence ï¿½ piger!ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Bratpfanne
de.gameText: Muss auf einen Hobbit gespielt werden. **Kampf:** Strenge den Trï¿½ger an, um einen Ork, den er bekï¿½mpft, zu verwunden.
de.loreText: Ich glaub', langsam hab' ich den Dreh raus.ï¿½

it.title: Padella
it.gameText:
Il possessore deve essere un Hobbit. 
**Schermaglia:** Sforza il possessore per ferire un Orco con cui stia schermagliando.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Mi sembra di cominciare ad abituarmici!'ï¿½

es.title: Sartï¿½n
es.gameText: El portador debe ser un Hobbit. **Escaramuza:** Esfuerza al portador para herir un Orco con el que estï¿½ en una escaramuza.
es.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Creo que le estoy pillando el truco!ï¿½

en.title: Meant to Be Alone
en.gameText: **Fellowship:** Spot a Hobbit companion (except the Ring-bearer) to reveal a card at random from an opponentï¿½s hand.  Remove <symbol>twilightX</symbol>, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½You are a Ring-bearer, Frodo... to bear a Ring of Power is to be alone.'ï¿½

fr.title: Destinï¿½ ï¿½ ï¿½tre Seul
fr.gameText: **Compagnie :** Dï¿½signez un compagnon Hobbit (exceptï¿½ le Porteur de lï¿½Anneau) pour rï¿½vï¿½ler une carte au hasard de la main dï¿½un adversaire. Retirez <symbol>twilightX</symbol>, oï¿½ X est le coï¿½t crï¿½pusculaire de la carte rï¿½vï¿½lï¿½e.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½Tu es le Porteur de l'Anneau, Frodon... porter un Anneau de Pouvoir signifie ï¿½tre seul.ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Dazu bestimmt, allein zu sein
de.gameText: **Gemeinschaft.** Entdecke einen Hobbit-gefï¿½hrten (auï¿½er dem Ringtrï¿½ger), um eine zufï¿½llig bestimmte Karte aus der Hand eines Gegenspielers aufzudecken. Verringere den Einfluss um <symbol>twilightX</symbol>, wobei X den Zwielichtkosten der aufgedeckten Karte entspricht.
de.loreText: Du bist ein Ringtrï¿½ger, Frodo. Einen Ring der Macht zu tragen, bedeutet, allein zu sein.ï¿½

it.title: Restare Soli
it.gameText: **Compagnia:** Avvista un compagno Hobbit (tranne il Portatore dellï¿½Anello) per mostrare una carta a caso dalla mano di un avversario. Rimuovi <symbol>twilightX</symbol>, dove X ï¿½ il costo crepuscolo della carta mostrata.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Tu sei il Portatore dell'Anello, Frodo... portare un Anello del Potere significa essere soli.'ï¿½

es.title: Destinado a Estar Solo
es.gameText: **Comunidad:** Avista un compaï¿½ero Hobbit (excepto el Portador del Anillo) para revelar una carta al azar de la mano de un oponente. Quita <symbol>twilightX</symbol>, donde X es el coste de penumbra de la carta revelada.
es.loreText: ï¿½Tu eres el Portador del Anillo, Frodo... Llevar un Anillo de Poder significa estar

en.title: Melilot Brandybuck
en.subtitle: Merry Dancer
en.gameText: **Response:** If a burden is about to be added by a Shadow card, exert Melilot Brandybuck to prevent that burden.
en.loreText: ï¿½Master Everard Took and Miss Melilot Brandybuck got on a table and with bells in their hands began to dance the Springle-ring: a pretty dance, but rather vigorous.ï¿½

fr.title: Melilot Brandebouc
fr.subtitle: Danseuse Enjouï¿½e
fr.gameText: **Rï¿½ponse :** Si un point-fardeau est sur le point dï¿½ï¿½tre ajoutï¿½ par une carte de lï¿½Ombre, affaiblissez Melilot Brandebouc pour empï¿½cher ceci.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ Le jeune M. Everard Touque et Mlle Melilot Brandebouc grimpï¿½rent sur une table et, clochettes ï¿½ la main, se mirent ï¿½ danser la saltarelle: une jolie danse, mais assez vigoureuse. ï¿½

de.title: Melilot Brandibock
de.subtitle: Frï¿½hliche Tï¿½nzerin
de.gameText: **Reaktion:** Wenn eine Lastmarke durch eine Schattenkarte auf den Ringtrï¿½ger gelegt wird, strenge Melilot Brandibock an, um dies zu verhindern.
de.loreText: Der junge Herr Everard Tuk und Frï¿½ulein Melilot Brandibock stiegen auf einen Tisch, und mit Schellen in den Hï¿½nden begannen sie den Springerreihen zu tanzen: einen hï¿½bschen, wenn auch ziemlich lebhaften Tanz.

it.title: Melilot Brandybuck
it.subtitle: Allegra Ballerina
it.gameText: **Risposta:** Se un segnalino fardello sta per essere aggiunto da una carta Ombra, sforza Melilot Brandybuck per prevenire quel segnalino fardello.
it.loreText: ï¿½Messer Everardo Tuc e la signorina Melilot Brandibuck salirono sul tavolo e, scuotendo una campana che tenevano in mano, si lanciarono nello Scattanello: un ballo molto simpatico, ma un po' troppo sfrenato.ï¿½

es.title: Melilot Brandigamo
es.subtitle: Bailarina Alegre
es.gameText: **Respuesta:** Si se va a aï¿½adir una carga por una carta de Sombra, esfuerza a Melilot Brandigamo para prevenir esa carga.
es.loreText: ï¿½El seï¿½or Everardo Tuk y la seï¿½orita Melilot Brandigamo se subieron a una mesa, y llevando unas campanitas en las manos empezaron a bailar el ï¿½Repique de campanasï¿½, bonita danza aunque algo vigorosa.ï¿½

en.title: Old Noakes
en.subtitle: Purveyor of Wisdoms
en.gameText: Each time a Shadow card makes you discard a card from hand, you may also discard a minion or Shadow condition.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½There's been some strange folk crossing the Shire ï¿½ Dwarves and others of a less than savoury nature.'ï¿½

fr.title: Le Vieux Chï¿½nier
fr.subtitle: Approvisionneur de Sagesse
fr.gameText: Chaque fois quï¿½une carte de lï¿½Ombre vous oblige ï¿½ dï¿½fausser une carte de votre main, vous pouvez aussi dï¿½fausser un sï¿½ide ou une situation de lï¿½**Ombre.**
fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½D'ï¿½tranges gens ont ï¿½tï¿½ vus traversant la Comtï¿½ ï¿½ des Nains, et d'autres encore mois ragoï¿½tants.ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Der alte Eichler
de.subtitle: Sprï¿½cheklopfer
de.gameText: Jedes Mal, wenn dich eine Schattenkarte zwingt, eine Karte aus deiner Hand abzulegen, darfst du einen Diener oder einen Schatteneffekt ablegen.
de.loreText: Seltsames Volk zieht durch das Auenland ï¿½ Zwerge und andere, zwielichtige Gestalten.ï¿½

it.title: Vecchio Naquercio
it.subtitle: Dispensatore di Saggezza
it.gameText: Ogni volta che una carta Ombra ti fa scartare una carta dalla mano, puoi scartare anche un servitore o una condizione **Ombra.**
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Ci sono strani personaggi che attraversano la Contea: Nani, e altri di una natura meno raccomandabile.'ï¿½

es.title: Viejo Nogales
es.subtitle: Proveedor de Sabidurï¿½a
es.gameText: Cada vez que una carta de Sombra te hace descartar una carta de la mano, tambiï¿½n puedes descartar un siervo o una condiciï¿½n de **Sombra.**
es.loreText: ï¿½Ha habido gente extraï¿½a cruzando la Comarca, Enanos y otros de una naturaleza menos sana.ï¿½

en.title: Seek and Hide
en.gameText:
**Stealth.**  
**Skirmish:** Spot 2 <symbol>shire</symbol> companions to make a minion lose all **damage** bonuses.
en.loreText: A Hobbit's best friends in Moria are the very pillars that support its structure.

fr.title: ï¿½ la Souris et au Chat
fr.gameText:
**Dissimulation.**
**Combat :** Dï¿½signez deux compagnons <symbol>shire</symbol> pour enlever ï¿½ un sï¿½ide tous ses bonus de **dï¿½gï¿½ts.**
fr.loreText: Les meilleurs amis d'un hobbit perdu au sein de la Moria sont sans contredit les piliers qui supportent la structure.

de.title: Suchen und Verstecken
de.gameText:
**Heimlichkeit.**
**Kampf** Entdecke 2 <symbol>shire</symbol> Gefï¿½hrten, damit ein Diener alle Schadensboni verliert.
de.loreText: Der beste Freund eines Hobbits in Moria waren die Pfeiler, die die Hallen stï¿½tzten.

it.title: Cercare e Nascondere
it.gameText:
**Segretezza.**
**Schermaglia:** Avvista 2 compagni <symbol>shire</symbol> per far perdere a un servitore tutti i bonus ai danni.
it.loreText: I migliori amici di uno Hobbit, a Moria, sono gli stessi pilastri che ne sostengono la struttura.

es.title: Al Escondite Jugamos
es.gameText: **Sigilo.** **Escaramuza:** Avista 2 compaï¿½eros <symbol>shire</symbol> para hacer que un siervo pierda todos los bonos al daï¿½o.
es.loreText: El mejor amigo de un Hobbit en Moria son los propios pilares que aguantan su estructura.

en.title: The Shire Countryside
en.gameText:
To play, spot 2 <symbol>shire</symbol> companions.   
Each time you remove a burden (except by a Hobbitï¿½s game text), you may heal a companion.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Life in the wide world goes on... scarcely even aware of the existence of hobbits....'ï¿½

fr.title: La Campagne de la Comtï¿½
fr.gameText: Pour jouer, dï¿½signer deux compagnons <symbol>shire</symbol>. Chaque fois que vous retirez un point-fardeau (sauf grï¿½ce au descriptif dï¿½un Hobbit), vous pouvez guï¿½rir un compagnon.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½ La vie continue dans le grand monde... ï¿½ peine conscient de l'existence des Hobbits.ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Landschaften des Auenlandes
de.gameText: Entdecke 2 <symbol>shire</symbol> Gefï¿½hrten, um diese Karte in deinen Unterstï¿½tzungsbereich zu spielen. Jedes Mal, wenn du eine Lastmarke entfernst (auï¿½er durch den Spieltext eines Hobbits), darfst du einen Gefï¿½hrten heilen.
de.loreText: Das Leben in der weiten Welt verlï¿½uft genauso.... Kaum jemand ist sich bewusst darï¿½ber, dass es die Hobbits ï¿½berhaupt gibt....ï¿½

it.title: La Campagna della Contea
it.gameText: Per giocarla, avvista 2 compagni <symbol>shire</symbol>. Ogni volta che rimuovi un segnalino fardello (tranne che per il testo di gioco di un Hobbit), puoi curare un compagno.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½La vita nel grande mondo va avanti... consapevole a malapena dell'esistenza degli Hobbit...'ï¿½

es.title: La Campiï¿½a de la Comarca
es.gameText: Para jugarla, avista 2 compaï¿½eros <symbol>shire</symbol>. Cada vez que quitas una carga (excepto por el texto de juego de un Hobbit), puedes curar un compaï¿½ero.
es.loreText: ï¿½La vida en el mundo sigue... Bastante ignorante de la existencia de los Hobbits...ï¿½

en.title: Three Monstrous Trolls
en.gameText:
**Tale.**   
**Response:** If a Shadow card is about to add any number of twilight tokens, exert a Hobbit ally to prevent this.
en.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Great big nasty twenty foot high smelly things ï¿½ and they're arguing... arguing about how they were going to cook us!'ï¿½

fr.title: Trois Monstrueux Trolls
fr.gameText:
**Rï¿½cit.**
**Rï¿½ponse :** Si une carte de lï¿½Ombre est sur le point dï¿½ajouter un nombre quelconque de jetons-crï¿½puscule, affaiblissez un alliï¿½ Hobbit pour empï¿½cher ceci.
fr.loreText: ï¿½ ï¿½ De grandes, sales choses puantes de six mï¿½tres ï¿½ et elles se disputent... se disputent quant ï¿½ la faï¿½on dont elles allaient nous faire cuire!ï¿½ ï¿½

de.title: Drei furchterregende Trolle
de.gameText:
**Erzï¿½hlung.**
**Reaktion:** Wenn eine Schattenkarte den Einfluss um einen beliebigen Betrag erhï¿½ht, dann strenge einen Hobbitverbï¿½ndeten an, um dies zu verhindern.
de.loreText: Vor mir drei furchterregende Trolle und die stritten sich untereinander: Wie sollten sie uns am besten zubereiten?ï¿½

it.title: Tre Troll Mostruosi
it.gameText:
**Racconto.** Giocala nella tua area di supporto.
**Risposta:** Se una carta Ombra sta per aggiungere un qualsiasi numero di segnalini crepuscolo, sforza un alleato Hobbit per prevenirlo.
it.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Grandi, orribili e puzzolenti esseri alti venti piedi, che discutono... discutono su come dovrebbero cuocerci!'ï¿½

es.title: Tres Monstruosos Trolls
es.gameText:
**Cuento.** 
**Respuesta:** Si una carta de Sombra va a aï¿½adir cualquier nï¿½mero de contadores de penumbra, esfuerza un aliado Hobbit para prevenir esto.
es.loreText: ï¿½Cosas apestosas, enormes de mï¿½s de tres metros, discutiendo... ï¿½Discutiendo sobre como nos iban a cocinar!ï¿½

en.title: Legolas
en.subtitle: Son of Thranduil
en.gameText:
**Archer.**

**Rastreador.** El nï¿½mero de sitio de cada Orco <symbol>sauron</symbol> es -3.

**Tracker.**

en.gameText:
**Tracker.**
The site number of each <symbol>sauron</symbol> Orc is -1.

Traqueur. 
Le numï¿½ro de site de chaque Orque <symbol>sauron</symbol> est de -1.

de.title: Orklï¿½ufer

en.gameText:
**Ring-bearer (resistance 10).**

**Portatore dellï¿½Anello (Resistenza 10).**

en.gameText:
**Archer.**

**Archer.**

en.title: ï¿½owyn

**Valiant.**

Vaillant. **

**Valoroso.**

**Valiente.**

es.loreText: ï¿½ï¿½Que los heraldos anuncien que la Dama ï¿½owyn gobernarï¿½ al pueblo!ï¿½

en.gameText:

**Skirmish:** Remove 3 <symbol>gandalf</symbol> tokens from here to make a companion strength +3.
en.loreText: To give his people time to escape, Brand stood against the Mordor army until he was slain. His friend, the dwarf Dain Ironfoot, stood over him until he too was slain.
